No matter where I go, I am a proud Pueblo woman — and when I wear my mocs or my ribbon skirt, I’m reminded of the strength of our ancestors and the responsibility we carry forward.

From my ancestral homelands to the halls of Congress, I’ve worn my traditional clothing with pride, honoring where I come from and the people who made my journey possible. On the day I was sworn in as Secretary of the Interior, I wore my white moccasins and a handmade ribbon skirt adorned with butterflies, stars, and corn. At the White House Tribal Nations Summit, I wore my beaded moccasins in solidarity with Indigenous people across the country. And when I filed my petition to appear on New Mexico’s ballot for governor, I wore my ribbon skirt to honor my ancestors at every step. clean_body: | = = Hi Peter, it’s Deb Haaland. No matter where I go, I am a proud Pueblo woman — and when I wear my mocs or my ribbon skirt, I’m reminded of the strength of our ancestors and the responsibility we carry forward. From my ancestral homelands to the halls of Congress, I’ve worn my traditional clothing with pride, honoring where I come from and the people who made my journey possible. On the day I was sworn in as Secretary of the Interior, I wore my white moccasins and a handmade ribbon skirt adorned with butterflies, stars, and corn. At the White House Tribal Nations Summit, I wore my beaded moccasins in solidarity with Indigenous people across the country. And when I filed my petition to appear on New Mexico’s ballot for governor, I wore my ribbon skirt to honor my ancestors at every step. And now, in just days, I will hopefully stand on stage again — wearing my mocs and ribbon skirt — and become the Democratic nominee for governor of New Mexico. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Three days. That’s all that stands between now and our primary election here in New Mexico — the most important moment of our campaign so far. All eyes are on this race, including national Republicans watching closely to see if we have the grassroots strength to win now and carry that momentum through November. And with just days left, reaching voters across our state and making sure they hear our message takes real resources. This is the moment where everything comes together — the work of months, the conversations across New Mexico, and the people-powered movement we’ve built — and it’s going to take all of us to finish strong. Peter, history has shown us there’s nothing we can’t accomplish when we work together, which is why I’m counting on the support of people like you as we fight for a New Mexico that works for everyone. = = I am so grateful for your support. body:
We can replace a longtime fixture of Washington politics with a progressive, working-class service industry worker.
#
Peter, the Colorado primary election is just one month away.
And in the critical race for CO-01, there’s one clear choice: **Justice Democrat Melat Kiros.**
She’s taking on the **15-term incumbent Rep. Diana DeGette** , a longtime fixture of Washington politics backed by corporate-aligned interests, like Big Pharma, AIPAC, and the Democratic establishment.
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260530-2-mk.gg5znT&refcode=em20260530-37843&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=2&akid=37843%2E1203867%2EGpG5MH)
Melat’s story is rooted in the same struggles she’s fighting to change. Born in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, she came to Denver with her family. Growing up, she watched her parents work multiple jobs and rely on community support to get by — experiences that shaped her belief in solidarity and genuine public service.
Today, she’s pursuing her PhD and works as a barista to pay off her student loans — all while running for Congress — knowing firsthand what it’s like to be a service-industry worker at a time when working-class people are struggling to get by and corporate profits soar.
**That’s why Melat’s not running to fit into the system — she’s running to _change_ it.**
She’s ready to fight for Medicare for All, housing as a human right, universal childcare, and ending U.S. support for endless war and genocide. Like all Justice Democrats, she rejects corporate PAC money and is building a grassroots campaign powered by working people.
**Melat’s already got the momentum.** At the Denver Assembly this past March, she received DOUBLE the support of her opponent, almost keeping DeGette off the primary ballot — serving as a clear signal that the people of Denver are ready for the change that Melat represents.
But when going up against a longtime incumbent backed by the biggest corporate interests in Washington, we need your help to turn that momentum into the resources needed to stay competitive in the final weeks ahead.
**[With just one month left, Melat is counting on grassroots support to keep reaching voters up until Election Day. Split a donation of $10 or more to Justice Democrats and Melat’s campaign TODAY so we can make it happen>>](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260530-2-mk.gg5znT&refcode=em20260530-37843&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=3&akid=37843%2E1203867%2EGpG5MH)**

In solidarity,
Justice Democrats

In each of these 26 states, the results from these Secretary of State elections will determine not just who holds those offices but how future elections are run and the shape of our democracy as a whole.

Driving pro-voting rights voters to the polls in November is the best possible response to all that we've been forced to live through the last decade. You want to know what this campaign looks like on the ground?
It's people with different backgrounds and stories, all in the same room, who believe that Tennessee's 4th District deserves better than what it's been getting. No corporate sponsor brought these people together. No corporate PACs check made this happen. Just neighbors who are tired of watching Washington make decisions that hurt their families while career politicians collect a paycheck and call it public service.
**Scott DesJarlais has spent 14 years chasing headlines, donor dinners, and party approval while MAGA tries to convince you democracy should look like AI generated slop.**

That's the difference between someone who represents a party and someone who represents people. Here's what I know after every event, every handshake, and every conversation we've had across this district: **people are ready.** They are fired up and looking for someone worth fighting for. clean_body: I'm not crying, you're crying. | | | | Peter, I get messages from voters every single day. But every once in a while, one stops me completely in my tracks. This is one of them.⬇️ Elizabeth wrote to us today and said: "My retirement check came a day early, so I sent you a small donation today. You are exactly the person I want in Congress! Keep up the great work, we have faith!" She didn't have to do that. She's on a fixed income, and she chose to invest in this campaign anyway. That's not something I take lightly. Not even a little bit. ~ | | ~ Here's what I want Elizabeth and every single voter like her to know: I won't let you down. That's not a talking point. That's a promise. This campaign exists because people like Elizabeth believe that ordinary citizens deserve a fighter in Congress. Someone who isn't bought, isn't beholden, and isn't going anywhere. ~ | ~ Thank you, Elizabeth. Truly. name: Kshama for Congress
subject: I am endorsing Butch Ware for Governor of California!
body:
Butch Ware is calling for universal single-payer healthcare, free public higher education in the state and canceling state-held student debt.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/kshamasawant/socialists-for-kshama-13701806?e=bbdb764b3a)

| | | | [|

| | Dear Peter,

I am endorsing Butch Ware for Governor of California!
Butch Ware is running independent from the Democratic and Republican parties as a Green Party candidate. He is calling for a universal, single-payer healthcare system, CalCare, free at the point of use for every Californian. His campaign is also fighting for free public higher education in the state and canceling state-held student debt.
Butch Ware is demanding that ICE detention centers on state contracts be closed, all state cooperation with ICE be ended, and that all residents be given access to social programs regardless of immigration or citizenship status. He is calling for a statewide $25/hour minimum wage and for a publicly owned energy grid built by unionized public-sector workers. Butch is calling for California's $800 billion+ in public pension funds to be divested from weapons manufacturers and corporations tied to war crimes.
The billionaire class and California’s Democratic Party, which absolutely dominates the state’s political machinery, are threatened by these demands brought forward by Butch Ware’s campaign. They have gone to shocking lengths, using despicable and blatantly undemocratic tactics to remove him from the ballot entirely.
This is reminiscent of how the ruling class and Trump-supporting billionaire landlords launched a recall campaign against me in 2021 when I was the socialist on the Seattle City Council, after my office won the nation’s highest minimum wage, the Amazon Tax, and unprecedented renters’ rights victories. Washington State’s Supreme Court upheld bogus charges against me and undemocratically scheduled the recall election in December, after the November elections were over, a clear attempt to disenfranchise working-class voters. Not a single Democratic Party politician publicly opposed the recall attempt. And yet, working people and I built a historic campaign and defeated the recall.
**I urge California’s working people to write in Butch Ware on the ballot.**
Shockingly, far from supporting Butch Ware, the overwhelming majority of labor leaders have endorsed billionaire Tom Steyer for Governor. These include the leaders of California Nurses Association, California Teachers Association, California Federation of Teachers, American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees (AFSCME) 3299, UNITE HERE, and the California AFL-CIO.
That the leaders of a swath of unions in the nation’s most populous and prominent state are cheerleading a billionaire venture capitalist indicates the horrific crisis in America’s labor movement, and the need for a reckoning in labor, the need for a militant rank-and-file-led fightback that can sweep these rotten labor leaders from office.
The leadership of the California Democratic Socialists of America formally issued a “No Endorsement” recommendation in their 2026 Primary Voter Guide, but they have [all but endorsed Steyer](https://us.list-manage.com/mnMSE5t3_LU?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) by claiming that “Tom Steyer is somehow running the most progressive campaign,” and that “the most progressive of the current viable candidates for governor is Tom Steyer.”
The capitalist class are parasitic by definition, since their profits only exist by robbing billions of workers of most of the wealth we generate through our labor.
Steyer's Farallon Capital is a “vulture fund,” which makes obscene profits for Steyer and its other billionaires and multimillionaires by pillaging hundreds of millions of working and poor people in poor neocolonial nations such as [Ethiopia and Mozambique](https://us.list-manage.com/rKGO45GPf5z?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15). These vulture funds target nations in economic crisis, “whose debt they can buy up at rock bottom prices” and then use legal threats to force the nations into ”making large debt repayments.”
The Financial Times recently reported that [vulture funds](https://us.list-manage.com/g7Nw8BZiuA9?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) that buy up "distressed assets at bargain prices ... have identified a downturn in private credit as their best opportunity since the [2008] financial crisis."
Steyer and his wife’s supposed nonprofit Beneficial State Bank has been found to have [grossly exploited](https://us.list-manage.com/a5XDuKByyYv?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) its auto loan borrowers from California’s poorest Central Valley counties: charging usurious interest rates on loans and then filing lawsuits upon default. Many of Steyer’s bank’s clients have described “spiraling into debt, unable to keep up with annual interest rates as high as 27.99% — only to lose their cars to repossession.”
On top of their effective stamp of approval for Steyer, the DSA leadership is also strongly objecting to a protest vote for a left independent candidate, claiming that “the chance of the top two candidates both being Republicans is still very real.” This is both shameful and untrue. The polls are showing that Democratic candidates (Steyer being one of them) are two of the top three in the poll just released. DSA leaders are running interference for the billionaire candidate of a capitalist political party — a shocking betrayal of working people, even for them.
The last time the California Governor was a Republican was 15 years ago. The last time the State Assembly had a Republican majority was in 1996. The last Republican-majority State Senate was in 1971. This is fearmongering, plain and simple.
**The Democratic Party has had the California Governor’s mansion and a supermajority or a near supermajority in both State houses and has crushed efforts for the CalCare universal public healthcare program FOUR TIMES within the last ten years — in 2017, 2022, and 2024, and earlier this year.** This is despite the fact that [86 percent](https://us.list-manage.com/rjDLL6hLKyK?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) of California supports single payer healthcare.
Any idea that the Democratic Party is a friend of working people has been disproven a thousand times over. Working people aren’t being fooled. Poll after poll has shown that tens of millions of working and young people are furious at the wars, the cost-of-living crisis, and are furious at both parties of the billionaires.
A [New York Times/Siena poll](https://us.list-manage.com/8pI_cHmHLy0?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) released yesterday shows that “political disillusionment seems only to be deepening.” The survey estimates that only 26 percent of voters are happy with the Democratic Party and only 33 percent with the Republican Party. Nearly two-thirds of respondents under the age of 30 are angry with both parties.
**I urge California’s working people to write in Butch Ware for Governor** , and for working people across the nation to join my revolutionary socialist campaign for the U.S. Congress to end all military aid to Israel, to win free healthcare for all funded by taxing the rich, and to stop the data centers and AI-related mass layoffs.
Solidarity,
Kshama Sawant

U.S. Senate candidate Graham Platner's campaign is reeling after a report Sunday revealed the far left progressive cheated on his wife with at least six other women, using an anonymous chat app described by the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children as a "[Predator's Paradise.](https://substack.com/redirect/2bfef7a4-32ec-47ad-8743-b6d3216141c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/873db004-c3ea-4c8a-8df5-33af1c913108?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Platner, who until Sunday was the front-runner in the Democratic U.S. Senate primary, admitted to the Wall Street Journal that he'd engaged in several adulterous affairs after marrying his wife, Amy Gertner, in 2023, while Gertner later confirmed her knowledge of the affairs in a video posted to social media.
Platner used the anonymous chat app "Kik" to arrange his clandestine assignations, using a profile of him shirtless and the user name "phustle0331."

P-Hustle is also the username Platner used with his now infamous Reddit account. The number in the handle -- 0331 -- is the U.S. Marine Corps Military Occupational Specialty (MOS) code for a machine gunner, which was Platner's MOS until he left the USMC in 2009. The Kik handle is also identical to the username Platner has used on [Instagram](https://substack.com/redirect/aabcaa1f-0f2f-4d2e-a331-64741548b0db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
In an image attached to the Kik account, Platner's tattoos are unmistakably visible, with the exception of the Nazi death camp tattoo on his chest, which is covered up by his phone.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c988b862-6c8c-4b50-b7a8-3edfd36667e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Screenshots reviewed by _The Robinson Report_ show the account was created in 2016, six years before Platner got married and when the self-described communist would have been 31 years old.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1db7facf-6321-4f80-af9c-a699175b6e15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Kik picture is sexual in nature, with the oyster farmer-turned-Senate hopeful facing a mirror, shirtless, with a towel wrapped around his waist. The flagrantly sexual nature of the profile picture is an odd move for a social media platform that, according to Search Logistics, has a user base that is 70 percent young people between the ages of [13 and 24](https://substack.com/redirect/ddd25ad9-20e4-4cc6-b7cf-9eade2e70bdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
As of Sunday afternoon, the account remained active despite Platner's campaign claiming he "deleted the app from his phone but hadn't deactivated his account."
### The Predator's Paradise
Kik, the WSJ noted, is a platform "widely used for sexual encounters." However, Kik isn't just known for promiscuous sexual encounters between consenting adults like Tinder, Hinge, or Grindr.
The app has also been singled out by law enforcement and child safety advocates as a key tool online predators use to target underage girls and boys for illicit sexual encounters.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/14d03a9d-086d-464e-a535-2d1ac45417cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Child abuse advocacy groups, such as the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC), National Center on Sexual Exploitation, and others like Thorn or Internet Matters have framed Kik's design features -- i.e. anonymity, low barriers to entry, stranger discovery, and group chats -- as enabling grooming, child sexual abuse material (CSAM) sharing, and exploitation, often calling it a high-risk or "predator-friendly" environment.
NCOSE has repeatedly labeled Kik a "predator's paradise," a phrase originating from a convicted child molester interviewed by CBS News, and placed it on its "Dirty Dozen" list of entities facilitating sexual exploitation. They document rampant grooming, CSAM trading, and prostitution ads, noting that anonymity and weak early moderation made it a haven.
Because of the nature of the app, there's no way to inspect Platner's interactions in the decade since he first downloaded it, but the WSJ did not surface any evidence that the Sullivan man used the app to communicate with underage girls or boys.
The Kik revelation is only the latest layer in a pattern that has Maine women speaking out publicly -- and raises uncomfortable questions about why a man running to unseat Sen. Susan Collins would maintain a presence on an app with such a notorious track record for enabling the worst kind of criminal behavior.
At the time Platner downloaded Kik, the app had already developed a reputation as a dark instrument for sexually deviant adults.
In February 2016, the [New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/1a2aca6a-592e-467a-9696-267c731e6f11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) highlighted the dangers of Kik in a story about two college kids who used the app to message Nicole Lovvett, a 13 year old girl and cancer survivor, before abducting and murdering her. The article said Kik has "increasingly become a source of concern for law enforcement" due to the "growing number of abuse cases" connected with the app.
More recently in Maine, the Kik app has been directly implicated in helping child predators connect with victims.
In September 2025, a Maine man was [arrested](https://substack.com/redirect/26ae7495-2de6-466b-a6eb-ac227ab224b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after he was caught snapping pictures of kids at soccer games, then using AI to turn those innocent shots into sexually explicit images and sending them around in Kik chats.
In June 2025, a [Maine man](https://substack.com/redirect/71f8f739-112a-4502-b914-0ea2ae434ede?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was hit with a 30-to-60-year prison sentence for producing videos of children being raped and then distributing that horrific material inside a dedicated Kik chatroom that existed for exactly that purpose.
In October 2024, another Maine man [pleaded guilty ](https://substack.com/redirect/2601992f-d1a3-4241-9de7-2186ab284cd7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)to possessing child sexual abuse material after he was caught sending and seeking child pornography through Kik.
In February 2023, a 31-year-old Maine man was [sentenced](https://substack.com/redirect/318ced9a-46cc-43da-b8bb-1e8cc2c89a66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for pretending to be a 19-year-old online so he could solicit nude pictures from underage girls on Kik.
Nationally, the numbers are staggering.
Advocacy reports cite over 2,000 federal criminal cases linked to Kik between 2014 and 2020 alone, with hundreds more in the years since -- including ongoing 2025-2026 prosecutions. In the UK, a 2018 BBC investigation found 1,147 police probes involving Kik for child sexual exploitation, grooming, and image offenses across nearly every major force. NCMEC's CyberTipline receives thousands of automated reports from Kik annually via hash-matching for known CSAM.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/146c55a6-2e8b-4c6b-8a5d-22c53a3d8289?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The revelation that Platner has spent ten years using the Kik app to arrange sexual encounters -- with adults, according to his campaign's statements to the WSJ -- is the latest sex-tinged scandal to rock the Democrat's campaign.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..jda7tKrvDCM0wWVjxz0jipJJZ5aeJ2rVgHnAk_RLlz0?)
Platner has spent recent weeks facing mockery over an old Reddit post in which he described his overpowering desire to masturbate whenever he uses a Portapotty as well as his various strategies for using prostitutes.
In the same week he announced his candidacy, reports began circulating in Facebook groups among Maine-based users who told tales of encountering Platner on various dating apps.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/77aef79f-1f7e-4e7d-959b-81535ac96290?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Screenshots from the Maine-based Facebook group "Are We Dating The Same Guy? | Maine / Portland / Lewiston / Bangor" show multiple women discussed "Graham Sullivan" (widely understood to be Platner) as a serial ghoster who popped up on dating apps despite being married.
Jessica Oram noted he "got married 2 weeks ago possibly."
Shelly and Jenny Racicot recalled him bullying classmates and spending time "on and off" with one woman as recently as 2.5 years ago.
Tracy Wright described matching in early 2020, daily texting, planned meetups that never happened, and assuming he had a significant other who "just came back into the picture."
Sara Stowe added he'd been "up to the same nonsense for at least 8 years."
One woman posted his photo with another man outdoors and warned: "I would definitely not recommend on any level."
Beyond the sexually deviant content tied to Platner, his Reddit account has also made national headlines and become fodder for political ads because of his criticism of rape victims, black people, rural white people in Maine, and U.S. military veterans.
He viciously mocked Purple Heart recipient and veteran Ted Daniels in a 2019 post about Daniels' helmet-cam footage from a 2012 Taliban firefight in which Daniels was shot four times protecting his squad. Platner wrote: "Dumb motherf----- didn't deserve to live... Poor marksmanship on the Taliban's part is the only reason this mouthbreather made it home." He has refused multiple times to apologize, even as Daniels -- who ran toward gunfire while Platner ran to a keyboard -- publicly called him out.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/724b41b1-cb8b-4ab1-b365-e493bcbb641d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Some national Democrats are circling the wagons in classic fashion, but it's unclear how many prominent left-wing influencers are actually being paid by the campaign to post positively about Platner.
The Democrat's most recent Federal Election Commission filings show large payments to a consulting firm called Good Influence, which allows candidates for office to buy favorable social media posts from large social media accounts without anyone having to disclose the pay-to-post relationship.
An investigation by the Washington Free Beacon found at least a few of the contractors known to work with Good Influence began posting glowing praise of Platner almost immediately after he entered the race.
A full list of social media users who are being paid to praise Platner is not available, as neither Good Influence nor Platner are required to disclose such arrangements.
As of Monday morning, Democratic gubernatorial candidates Troy Jackson, Shenna Bellows, and Hannah Pingree -- all of whom happily campaigned with Platner and coveted his support -- had not commented on the news that Platner's hobbies extend well beyond farming the occasional oyster.

The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | Today's Top Pick (ads) | • | Research Boulevard ---|--- • | Awesomely • | Immersed | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. ## Bus Driver Facing Charges in Fatal Crash
The driver of the bus involved in the I-95 crash that killed five people and injured 44 others in Virginia on Friday was [a non-English speaker](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQRp8GdxPB4L8ULrZxd7fd0iIwmNlLIALiyG-_8n2FrT_p6Dvnz9f2ZThy2n-bJy3N5y3Rp0ZqjcrmTTPx8a62mBpsMGWnagMn2lDiCHIArTZnOJ5b37nFEyHpjhY1zRIRZY9dWB5q8krbUfe9mYdJzcb31kk3ox48yanj5aLJQSsl5aTuN2tG5ef7dB_v4zRrJ3pJjlsut7-ZUwvk45kPKjebn11cQmuvKvQvgavANZ2vXNs1CVwvsMBVDgJXLQWu7wqXn8D14LJzYgOPd4UfQWjBNPjmGMnBAJyOHA9ykHICSnvkGqC-yHxz2sEVPqjAJ2TYc4PIllIl4ATphGrOCpVMAvf2_hS4dmVxrw_HyHWcRC_3p-H487_9V_RjwX8BAAD__-A5lrg), according to Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy. [Charges are pending](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAUhJ_GdCD7-A8KF7dxlzR3V1siBx_grBxA2AnK26-I9g22ntHMfPN16S-BEi3TNdzRlXHtFzxywlJw78dQQro98rCHPA9z2CfMw0wL9sDB1FzXUvQxUHr1qopuRASUFTphWw4AXEE1O6GVMHJUOmrF4wCqNaMQRkWL0motKnJnGtdSCM6t6JohGDG2ne1MZ2wrI1McI5V1b75XWsqMY3qtT9ybYb1Xyc2lbJnJfww8A38cR_PY6NQY-I916694ZAb-8z8DfzYx8Fwz8JIz8L9U9YZLpGWqn7RPtFCob49cv7lPpzEnktDCGsHAV7uL20EpUTaWKT7dA6X3mvKnC58OfgIAAP__nXp_yg) for Jing S. Dong, a Chinese native with U.S. citizenship, who was driving the motorcoach from New York City to Charlotte, North Carolina when it struck a Chevrolet Suburban near Quantico, just after 2:30 a.m. Duffy posted on social media: "_Any company, trainer, or school that contributed to[putting an unqualified driver on the road](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO4yAQgOGnwV2iYcAeU1CcdHKXa67Y0prAELMidmRIsnn7VfYVtv2Lr_g_TvOJc8nr5R9fxbe0zas8a5HWZJ8TNy7new071yUsvF-khiWvMiPgcID-YPQcOZfXbLvokwiK6cRrGgERwWK3-DP0Ep2TaJykQDpoShRTikiBOXGX_VuD3mgNQNodAw86jY7c4AYaTVQWJOa27cfPLa9tkVRe20P2Y9iuXfFLa7eqzB-Fk8Lp610VTv8l_L2n9FI41cbtXhVOCANYsv1IQBrImlF3u4-3Zy4l14GUhcuVc_mB269uPDx-BwAA__9TenD8) will face intense scrutiny._" In addition to the 25-year-old woman who was killed when the bus struck the Suburban, the accident [claimed the life of a family of four](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0bGOnDAQxvGnMZ1XZmxgKSjudHKKaNOkSImMPYZJjFnZZglvH-1ppTzA1X9ppN98v27jzVCgOP8wKw7Fb2PEIwcsBdPoTTFh2rNNJi92MWnGbBeKOIKAlouGy3p0hsI5qsoNHhFQVjjU3VUAgFBQLUNfO9PBZJ2RjRXYeevtNE2qEb5tQamKhuc10ci6FqKr-4s1be2vfde3fdtdpWNKoKOypcvvjWJZ0Idze2C62G2twrCUcs9MvjHQDPRxHJc1x2djoDFyszPQTxQDTTHTvBQG2tMD-R8KAR13iR6YuDeW4sxfTm58wcSJ9w2f9sw_f8BAzyv_dlPvGt777o1JPeP6M5p7XrbyHU8mP_5Xnl-BKwbt_nfdHDL5kfbprNLg7geFQLntmBLzaih8esqXRngM8C8AAP__H42bBA) when it caught fire after the collision.
## US Upholds Hormuz Blockade
The U.S. military [stopped another merchant vessel](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu3CAURL_G7ljBxcamoEiz3Uub0rqGYU2E7RWwb7X5-sj5hZSjkUZzzq-v5YtTTsfjJ-9wLZ7LgXfNaA1lidw4r6_qC9fNb1weqH5LBxaSZIQchVZL4JQ_y9AHFwGC7uHUNEsikgP1mwPWGFbrrZmVHsY1xFVHrONko5GrQp_ctSZHrZSUk7I3z0bF2U7WWDPNOnSDREjtLLffZzrahpg_5zfKzZ97n93W2rN2-kdH947u_LwAruoKpSWf0dE9FT7E60gNQdTGDVW8uYjtLPvrj_DgipgKBANsFVRQZiZMINKkRkUwGJj12BcXnu-Uc6pm6gb52Dnlf0faf9n7dvQ3AAD__1Jlg4A) trying to break through the American blockade of Iranian ports on Saturday. The Gambia-flagged bulk carrier was disabled by U.S. aircraft in the Gulf of Oman, marking the sixth time the military has stopped a ship trying to breach the blockade. Meanwhile, President Trump is weighing a ceasefire extension with Iran that would [restore free navigation through the Strait of Hormuz](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO2zAQAF9DdTTIpSRKBYs06i5tSmGPWpmb0KRB7tlwXh84X7h6gBlgfn3sH8iZy_Un3ijIWfdCz55JhNp-omD-_OqxYU8xYbtSj4kL7WBg1mbSzu4Hcn7t43CEkwjIDRSsXwwAmBGGFPxo_WicX5djdoCnj9bY2SOZaSW_LAOHt81MzlpjvF0vEWd7Lqtf53X2izvUaOhgqe3yu3KRRGd-1Qe1S6y3IYckcu_K_VCwKdgkUeKc30zBdq-Z40vBxkWoFRSuBbOCbVoNjJPTdxLSia6dJGluWPQTmy74wKw_c41_8CDdpSGLrqdOtd2-_irYhhaO-5Nz5j57NZrrDfl_dJBvXXwE-BcAAP__2gGGIg), a central condition of a tentative agreement reached between the two sides last week. At stake is a 60-day extension for new talks on ending Iran's nuclear program. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth said on Saturday that the U.S. is "more than capable" of [resuming war with Iran](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOrSAYhJ8GOwyCB7WguI3due2W5hd-hA2CATzGt9-4r7DtZDLz5ft6L2_wwcftP-yoqk1LxKsErBXzYqFCWM-iMxSnHeQNi3Y-4sIZl5S9qOgWAz7cS98YZRE5igZVN4yMc8563jglNY6j1FxMUgCIbhW9ley1jqa3Pcqx8epZYy_RdYwN3dRqkJ0dp2GSkxxGYUjP0PiacvudfKwObbjTB3Or094E5Wo9ChH_CJ8Jn6_raqvD7YRsPMSn86QpB0P4_DwRPu9wEz4LRvh8FrqnjLQ6iFTDAWtAmizNWM7dx41ekCls4GOp1GeI9MCK1OFWsDpa4C5NVua4fAi-yIH0bNvBh1-4-iejH8V_AgAA__-3x4rO).
## Adult Smoking Reaches Record Low
Cigarette smoking among U.S. adults [reached an all-time low of 9% last year](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uwzAUg09jbw6efqyfQUOXbOna0ZClJ_u1sh1ISoLcvnCv0I0EAYIfv27TzVOmffn0G7qWjmnHV83YGpYp-ebz_Kih-LqG1ZcFa1hpx4kDVwOMg2BT9JTfk-yjS4gcRY-OaQOcc5C8Xx2YOcoZIIEck5LJjN5HSFzKOQimTU_ubINRMAagmb0Er1gyVltllTYidhIwUjvK5fugva2Y8vt4YrmEY-uzW1u71058dPza8au_nwBndJrSKGQ8VXzkNtTt-KF9GQItvpyMQ8SQacehPsoT34OIKdhoeAqBgUJp_ahBGWajFIYL2xcX7y_KmarSnYRl85T_drR_nfd0_DcAAP__nhGB9w), according to findings from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. In the mid-1960s, 42% of U.S. adults were smokers. The rate has been gradually dropping for decades, due to cigarette taxes, tobacco product price hikes, smoking bans, public education campaigns, and changes in the social acceptability of lighting up in public. The [use of electronic cigarettes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D3unDAUBPDTmM4rf4AxhYs0KM0_TYqU6GE_sBODV_bbRXv7iFwh9Uij-c2vr-ULUk7n_gMOdLSV5cSrZSTCumxAkNdX8xVa9BHqjs3HdOKihDJcDFzLJUDKn6XvgtsQFeoOnRytUEqJXnXR-bCugKgkiHXbRLAmjL21frDBCoOmS-5uE4OWUohRTg8PRm52GiczmdHqwHqBIVGpj98lnRRxy5_yxvrw5eiyi0TPxvQ3pmamZlj9LbgzpubvCJkiU_OVKv6kUj9Mza_GIbwycZ92qDeVt6P8SefOKxDymKhxSgfyXC4ute61VkPfVReeV8o5NTOyXuwHpPxvA_3XcW-n_gYAAP__-ECCsQ) has increased among adults, but held steady in 2025, at about 7%. Another recent study shows a connection between [violence exposure and increased teen use](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDty8yAUhVeDOjRw0bOg-Bt1_suk1Fyji0SCQAPYsnefsbOElOcU5_F9XuYLOu_C-h930sXGOdCZPZVCabZY0F9v2STMm9kwrZTN5gLNIKDjouVKzgs6_5ybatGWCEhVpGU_CAAQDVSbNgqVAitEIwbZtqZvR5S2JepNQ601ldOvNNEqKYXo5Vgb7KQdxn7sxq4f1MIaQYsrMdVf0YWykfXPeKdUm7hXXm-lHJmpfwwmBtN5nvXrAt9pcQZ9HagwmF4Wg-m3CUYG04eLnoIhTo8j5lsi7l34poWXyF0wiTC_xRWNifyWieMew8oLUcg15uNRJb0cp_Pe5a5njVh3dP49qvyJ5F3DTwAAAP__2W2ImQ) of cigarettes and e-cigarettes, suggesting a possible coping mechanism.

**Whatever happened to stamp collecting?** It started with a single British penny. When the world's first adhesive postage stamp, the "Penny Black," bearing a profile of Queen Victoria, went on sale in May 1840, people began hoarding them almost immediately. (You can [buy one in mint condition](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykk8mO4jwQx5_G3KblLbZz4OAE6GZ62MKSCReUxUncWUlMAjz9J_geYS6l0r_--qlUi7-6rEJd6jpbh5WamrS51GrsS2WM6i5paMIyuvVxF_Z5nIddpvo417W6YIjZL2j9IuiShLp8XOgkmaZKYUUmaoq4gBhjSPEkn0JFOVMRTUI7QpDFIUOQYRVH3KYkVmKipy8atAhCEHJkf7wsqbC5zWzGBUkAhSrRpuk-fhpdm1yl5aMZVPcRN9WknObGtD0gEuAFwItxHD9UFD5eRYAX2rwiohRianMbIwLI4tIXIyCzVtX1A2AnKsO4ANjpTVi1ADtIUAiwU-naAMy0qSplQkBmEH3vPU7hIljLv_t54AvuUvIl5h7ALA_7HJCZNqrCSAihYg4TQGQGiJy1vZSb_TgfTtmPJP7_1LZrAZmpOgbYIlLu5B8ppSM_02CxLUb97fr0vN73-IbQ3U31H96Q59_NNi92PNN4JkgJsIUXXqdrd4_eOUer_c92UaREXHfj0u_EsIvpvagse8i_65WbJ-tT9rbqoDwMj2dw3KZP8_WWksg7De26yJP8zmR8PgTznLm75dnq2FzdlRHtqSde-3vFtjc_weaK_ICNRBz6NFyvkpX1HCJXXoMRO7xlIhqzz8E-YoMe0fq4S-gyL8zXvZaH1dHhVX3ODkZVhSWv98N3mn37Iz0NzNTe9cwaE8JPmLXOM1oOjP5uTl_Fht7efd5F6j7Y00vRkdv486U5t9zN04J4vRh68rCye_bcKNw6t9leHJo9PK-bYH7ytN9T0g-2Gc83cxrF8TX7GcAWd03RvhfhFPbes9xlsUw353HSTZN21GWpe8YBhVkV6vJ9eOafvmWY4v8CAAD__6nGHfI) today on eBay for about $4,000). Within a decade, collecting had spread across Europe and to America, and by the 1880s, an estimated 25,000 U.S. enthusiasts were already cataloguing and trading. In 1893, the first U.S. commemorative series, honoring the World Columbian Exposition, sent interest soaring further. A new hobby had found its audience. By the early 1970s, philately wasn't just a hobby--it was practically a civic institution. The U.S. Postal Service estimated that 20 million Americans collected stamps, nearly one in 10 people. Kids soaked them off envelopes, catalogued them in albums, and traded them at school. The USPS leaned in hard, issuing splashier commemorative designs and even declaring October "National Stamp Collecting Month" in 1981. And collectors developed different styles of holding and displaying their treasure, [as this video shows](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu6yAUgOGnwVssONgGBoa7eLlKp0ptJwvjQ6AiJoKTWHn7Kn2Fzr_0Df_HeTm7lNN-eXNXtBTKsuPRMhJhXYIjl9d789W16KOrF2w-ph0X4DCd-HiSYtlcys9l6DYbEAFlh1YozQGAD9BFu2ptcEVjRqGN2YZRrlKAGp30Qo3Bdcm-ND5KIThXwvTeTSJoo8xkJqXlxgaOW6JS---SdooY8rM8sPa-XLtsI9GtMfmPwcxgPo6jf5Y73Vd8dQZzi6VSYzCH_9qf-PsnfZ27arfbkXJObVJs4JerS_nXoz9NeFj4CQAA__89D29c). Then the bubble popped. As the collector base swelled through the late '70s, speculators piled in, and stamp values doubled year over year between 1977 and 1980. When that frenzy collapsed, it left a bad taste. The organized hobby kept growing--the American Philatelic Society peaked at nearly 58,000 members in 1988--but decline had set in. What followed was a slow bleed that the philately hobby couldn't survive. Email killed the stamped letter. Self-adhesive stamps cut off the easiest entry point for new collectors. The Junior Philatelic Society of America folded entirely. A generation grew up and a stamp album felt about as relevant as a butter churn. The APS today counts roughly 23,000 members, less than half its 1988 peak, and many collections assembled over decades are worth a fraction of their former value on resale. Two bright spots remain. At the ultra-rare end, serious money still trades--a single 1856 British Guiana stamp fetched $9.5 million at Sotheby's in 2017. But there's a way to outsmart the supplement industry and get real results. | Whatever happened to stamp collecting? It started with a single British penny. When the world's first adhesive postage stamp, the "Penny Black," bearing a profile of Queen Victoria, went on sale in May 1840, people began hoarding them almost immediately. (You can today on eBay for about $4,000). Within a decade, collecting had spread across Europe and to America, and by the 1880s, an estimated 25,000 U.S. enthusiasts were already cataloguing and trading. In 1893, the first U.S. commemorative series, honoring the World Columbian Exposition, sent interest soaring further. A new hobby had found its audience. By the early 1970s, philately wasn't just a hobby--it was practically a civic institution. The U.S. Postal Service estimated that 20 million Americans collected stamps, nearly one in 10 people. Kids soaked them off envelopes, catalogued them in albums, and traded them at school. The USPS leaned in hard, issuing splashier commemorative designs and even declaring October "National Stamp Collecting Month" in 1981. And collectors developed different styles of holding and displaying their treasure, . Then the bubble popped. As the collector base swelled through the late '70s, speculators piled in, and stamp values doubled year over year between 1977 and 1980. When that frenzy collapsed, it left a bad taste. The organized hobby kept growing--the American Philatelic Society peaked at nearly 58,000 members in 1988--but decline had set in. What followed was a slow bleed that the philately hobby couldn't survive. Email killed the stamped letter. Self-adhesive stamps cut off the easiest entry point for new collectors. The Junior Philatelic Society of America folded entirely. A generation grew up and a stamp album felt about as relevant as a butter churn. The APS today counts roughly 23,000 members, less than half its 1988 peak, and many collections assembled over decades are worth a fraction of their former value on resale. Two bright spots remain. ## Dallas Explosion Kills 3, Search Ends
Dallas Fire-Rescue [ended its search](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL3ymzAQxJ9GdPLoAzAuVKSh-6dNyQjdydzkQIwkg_32GfwKae9md3-7f36mH09M2_O3X9HVd0zThmdhrBXzVPZXLh4OvwXcUyk0M5aa8joZZXqpOmn1BJ74M7UNuFnBQzfo9H1QxnStNs3iAti7Bt0BQIx2MMOMw8MbY_sQoAfTkLvMVGe11spadevjY-juKsxhHhS2SrQKgWrKt7pgxbcvkT_pwHwLaW3YLbXuRdhfwozCjOd53sJcrhbXX5jxKxFmvE7CjOCZfZF-97muuFWJ751TobTJSBll8n9lYIpR1gVl4A-gRJaZgs-Q5PwiBtqeMmO4IGRBn8MiyysfdKR8RTTZwX4SM5X-Llr1XD3xl7b-38aHM_8CAAD__97QlgM) Friday at a leveled Oak Cliff apartment complex, confirming all residents were accounted for after a deadly gas explosion. Thursday's blast at [the Clyde building](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OrDAQhE9jMlC7bf4CBy8hm5duiBrczFgy2LK9A3P7FXuFzSooVen7vh7zg5x3x_M_7WzKtYX54DN7LoXTnON3ymTfdKwcQ85u8ZxLSPuMgF0Nba3kbMn5z6wraxawo6zYyH4AxFZLrF5G66HX60hDt5AcJCONqusYZcsK2mWtnLnHoFVSSlAKmm4bh7aHdVmXAViD0MDWlZCa8uLCF-XNf8KbU7OGvfLmVUrMQv0TOAmczvNstnDpG-MuCJzuKHCy5D3lmiKlsvNRar6iD9mFo97pU-NYJWPj6bx3ueuFhudOzv-elL-peRv8CQAA__-bwXlu) on East Ninth Street killed three people--two women and a child--and hospitalized five others. The five-alarm explosion leveled the two-story complex and drew 120 firefighters. Neighbors said the blast shook nearby homes and flung debris; the community held a vigil Friday. Attorneys for victim Sylvia Collins' family [vowed to seek answers](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL-OszAQxJ_GdEb28i8ULr6GLl97JVrsdbDOYGTvheTtT-QVrp3RzGh-X_f5jiGG_fEfNzL88mne6SyRmCnP5fjJBd0Td0tHKiUskQqnvM2goJeqk42eHYb4ntvKmUW5UVdk9HBTAF2roVrN2LneAfmmsW5QrW7diLoj1N0yLqD7KpirTHWN1lo1jap7P966QdnFLjdFrRKtIhc45ZpXYnph8fGdnpRrm7YqmpX5KKL5J2ASMJ3nWdulXC8uX8D0iQiYLknA5DBGLBIPzLzRztKHTHLkVRbORCwTfksbg_cCpiobd5whxlD6QbTqsWGIn13-G62ngd8AAAD__xRAgDY). Atmos Energy says a construction crew [damaged a gas line](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO5CAQBNCvwRkjaGPPOHBwibO99EKrgWYHCQyiWXv2709z9wkbl_RUVX8-9g-MKR6fvzHT2l-h7AddnKh3ajvXr8boTzwc1cIcbSLupeUdFMxSTXLUu8eYvncz-NUqv-iBVn1_KIDJaBieq55nB95668M9jAFN0HZBAwHJLLNSQ1zfmJpGrbUaR3Wbw_KY7spZZx-KjBJGkY-9tFt_UqcXckjf5aR2cyUPaX32XlmMvwRsArbrum6HdT5c71jA9t4jYEvFYRKwgcSELcsQG0ns0kZ-liqxdZZYsfVMR5eu5JroJWsruXaWGZnjSbIR13IwydBKlh5TQv5PNWL3RQI2o2CZRi1gG9rq6xVTijzfhVGfGWP6V7r_7Opzhb8BAAD__yfEloQ), and the NTSB is investigating.
## Texas Border Arrest Law Cleared
A federal appeals court on Friday [cleared Texas Senate Bill 4](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykUD2SgyAUPg12OA9E1IJiG7tsu6XzlGfCDIgDbEhuv2OusN1XfP8_t-WGzrvj_o2BTHntcTmoZk-lUFry-Zsy2iceG50xZ7d6yiWmsEiQmkPPO7FYdP69qMaaFewkGjJiGEHKXgnZPMymlditEgOuHdlxn7SYei16uyFYRN04c5lB3wkhoOug1fs09gNs67aOQAqYArKuxNSWBxV6Yd79Oz4ptVsMjTePUs7Mui8mZybnWmu7x5e6ZlwEJucLMjl_pNyF4O4Ji4sH91h5XrniAd9cTvwq0iRjz-q8d1kPTME9oPOfpPK_f55G_gUAAP__I5d6cA) to take effect, reversing an injunction blocking the state's sweeping border law. The Fifth Circuit ruled challengers lacked standing, freeing a law that lets state and local police [arrest suspected illegal crossers](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAUhJ_GdF75F0NBkYbupk2Jju3DYsVgZJ9d7n37iH2FtDPSN_rmz9fyBSmn4_kbdpzoey3LgVfLSIR1aeerNohvOAKepbXkMzYqdV-UUD0Xlmu5REj5ZzFdnLyIo-xwkm4QSlkjVbdNaEcDUTo9rm5cxRgHCb0cfe8G7XRwXZpumLBaSim0Fo9-HQfrRPDBDwKNYEZgTFTqgzYk_Ia25p_yxvoIZe_ytBGdjelfTM1Mzdd1Pf5u5XWXTM1QKYWMTM23F1NzOzEkyLziWSrdCRCnDbkvNWJlav5M8LTv6VmBUjl4hos3PICQ-5QzN_x1RqCbqgbL0aLrnVMcfIjcWCX46I3kwQ0gVm21g7WrUzyvlHNqvWNGPHdI-SNA_3f7e1L_AgAA___45pXp) and lets Texas judges order deportations--powers normally reserved for federal officials. Civil rights groups condemned the ruling and [vowed to keep fighting](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykz7FuwyAQgOGnwVus44xtMjC0g7d06dARYTgnqDhYcLWTt6_SV-j8S5_0f13sxcUU79cPt5Lhx5LtnY6aiJmKrdtPqS7s7u5py7XGOVHlXFaLgMMJ-lMnbXAxPa1qgpkhnGVDRo4aEHslsbkZNSCBdp2eERZ3Dl7rcVYDqt5Rv4ShieaFQd9JKaHroB2Ws-5H8LOfNZACoYBC5FxavhHTw9UlPfNOpfV5bZK5MW9VdG8CJ4HTcRztd3X8igInzlv0AqfPd6sETk0xYTtiSrEOo1BwXV1Mfw7_7343-BsAAP__OrVt7Q), warning it could subject Hispanic Texans to stops based on race, not legal status. Texas passed SB 4 in 2023 amid record-high crossings; it takes effect with [encounters at record lows](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuupDAQRVdjMiP_-AUOJiF7k06IbFxASQYju2i6dz-it_CSUgVH916dfz_Tj8OIx_rX7WDpvaTpgLtEIII8lfPKxYWXO2Y4UynoIxRKeZ-UUC0XDddyCg7jZzJVsF6EQVZgZdcLpRojVbVZUK32WjVi6U23mMG03dAGCcoMoQ9eV2ifMNFoKaXQWtTtMvRNJ2Y_-16AEcwICEgp17QBwduVJX7SC3I9p72KdiM6C9N_mBqZGu_7rr8QZfTXAXXKK1Pj08HUKMzzP-fLcNx3XLMjTAeP7ubFc8Mb2viMeb6Q-JyuTDwt3J0nuFh4vh5dTI1VtuG8MUYsbceMWHeH8TuJfifyZdX_AAAA__9lrIe2).
## Spurs Stun Thunder, Reach Finals
The San Antonio Spurs [bucked heavy odds](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDvO3CAURleDO6zLNX4VFGncTdqUFo_LGAVjC5jxzO4jZwt_faRP5zt_HutDhxjS87feSdWPP9ZEV4lUK-W1nK9ctHvrZOk8SgkmUqlH3lcEHDj0vBOr0yF-V9k4ZcDNoiElxgkQeymw2ZQH36OzNHXS9KOT1g9CmmmWsxVmHqAJ6h6DvhNCQNdBO_h56kewxpoJSAKTQC7UI7d1o0ofXXz8Hm_KrT32Jqqt1rOw7hfDheFyXVdL5Uw3ZLgkoxkut_SX4bIyXIJjuMhpxl52eLP7JC_1lXjdXslR5k-9Ex953XKIkTLf9V_iyWjuQ9KxNFm58woxhjKMTMJz1yH-l6k_S_hW-C8AAP__j8CFsw) to beat the defending-champion Oklahoma City Thunder 111-103 on the road in Game 7 Saturday night, reaching the NBA Finals for the first time since 2014. | A personal note from Steve | Before June 2nd
---|---
Dear Friend, I wrote this because I do not want this moment to pass quietly. You get a lot of campaign emails. I know that. Most of them are overly urgent and instantly forgettable.
| | ★ |
---|---|---
Deadlines. Buttons. Exclamation points. The usual performance. **This is not that.** I wrote you a real note because **June 2nd is almost here** , and after that, this race moves on with us or without us.
|
---
Please read what I wrote | [Read My Message](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=33cd4d7451a94fb7808fcc1d6745bd78&_e=0qtPR09rAhteu3GGjAMXkl9YnkDt_u5PH1un9zH8-l_w-Rn2jAALfhYlM5e48S7q058xp1M3phKnNYNsTBx8j5YOUd19AS1dyCpP6bUjRjT-YkTdabZfA4o-yXXNz-oyzayqVTJxiLA2KVE9BXgTJDxc8UxLmina-Qsb3B7KJiAbVt-IVrKd422VmxtpzcEObtxR78oxjRTIfyFFpCWukYJ4paKGnQ6dLRxX-kTnJi_N0piplue5J_cuuVCYeSrIxK6T-KpvlAKzwGsplfqXYolmGojGXbhZyMffT9COHUQMOFWrzmkR4e6nMPZBrAGJVe9ignJ2dDg3Iwrqk8nC4d3Vf3aGtQs_9Zc_Tn8H_Cc6L968CilzYiysLeeO0BekdAexlfGF0cCvrA_CosdZmHqD6ETGt7-KgaBWbU2M-FE0VUVr_Cg7AhwiA_3SiyhlminS799WpnN22yqTSndd5b3ds-x55Jqd3z8WKCsXY08%3D)
---

| There is no automatic Republican nominee in California. There is no second chance if we fall short. There is no clever explanation that will make up for failing to do everything possible while there was still time.
---
**That is the brutal, unavoidable fact.** And frankly, I do not want this to be the last serious message I send to Americans across the country about this campaign because Democrats managed to stop us before November. **That would be a bitter, ridiculous ending to a fight we can absolutely win.**
| Before the window closes Help me keep this campaign moving. | [Stand With Me](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=33cd4d7451a94fb7808fcc1d6745bd78&_e=0qtPR09rAhteu3GGjAMXkl9YnkDt_u5PH1un9zH8-l_w-Rn2jAALfhYlM5e48S7q058xp1M3phKnNYNsTBx8j5YOUd19AS1dyCpP6bUjRjT-YkTdabZfA4o-yXXNz-oyzayqVTJxiLA2KVE9BXgTJDxc8UxLmina-Qsb3B7KJiAbVt-IVrKd422VmxtpzcEObtxR78oxjRTIfyFFpCWukYJ4paKGnQ6dLRxX-kTnJi_N0piplue5J_cuuVCYeSrIxK6T-KpvlAKzwGsplfqXYolmGojGXbhZyMffT9COHUQMOFWrzmkR4e6nMPZBrAGJVe9ignJ2dDg3Iwrqk8nC4QU4dF5zj58ZeSx-a4x6t3Y-W9aWlpmysAfR_vZHQ2Xnufd23mX2A52Nh8FgYTpTcXH5utuyawsB5wnY5rbtXkXqfw4Iekye-vAvKTPA_ERP2w6eLEyk4iEKSAV_fF8RFx-iuw0VxGUgs0IY3xRfkzI%3D)
---
So before you scroll past another campaign email, I want you to read the note I wrote. It explains exactly where this race stands, why Democrats want us buried before June 2nd, and why I believe they are terrified of facing us one-on-one in November. They should be.
|
---
_Thank you,_
_Steve Hilton_
_Authorized by Hilton for Governor 2026_

name: Mark Kelly
subject: My decision
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I know we’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. With elections coming this November, the stakes are higher than they have ever been. The fate of our democracy hangs in the balance.
Hey folks, it’s Mark Kelly.
Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate.
I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.
But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something.
So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too.
I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help.
I know we’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. With elections coming this November, the stakes are higher than they have ever been. The fate of our democracy hangs in the balance.
After everything that’s already happened, I wish I didn’t have to ask you for more. But that’s what I need to do.
**[I’m asking you to split a donation between Chris Pappas and me. We’re going to do everything we can to take back Congress this November, and Chris Pappas needs your help. I just hope you know that I wouldn’t be asking if this wasn’t important.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260531_1.ieXbTT&amount=5&refcode=em20260531-1&t=1&akid=6906%2E582294%2E4t_-kZ)**

Thank you.
Mark

Peter,
It was just revealed that the U.S. Postal Service is moving forward with a plan to limit mail-in voting by only sending ballots to voters who are registered on a list approved by the federal government.
This is an unprecedented assault for free and fair elections.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018oPL69OH1q5ogsQipMYCgWZJODHsLmlhKlxEJWeWo3w8lQiR8MRxmN1XJDNHI5sByZZ1kUPnhhr_EzRrA8UaDosTPildaNLRhyEJd7vMK2O9_ltzbpp4WVoFQbyO4dMRwRoCZHyILSpTG7_Fl6zrcy69mOroTzZlFiVw2p5jz1-oYpmqeySPnAa7KTU0PG2Pf7g8YJ1hjEv9wvaTSu74Znv8elVGOUgD&c=-vm2Tvbtr9gYbd8IHeYtdNNYUS30aRX_hI5pY3V5pv40vqYpeNGy5g==&ch=ACdE1XFJPNgSYvrZMGTfcc5OpgqgZVnnIWCYLTZyKBRb6qJCi4TILA==)
---
This rule would effectively give the Trump admin control over who receives ballots and who doesn't.
We do not have to imagine how Trump uses this power. Live in a heavily Democratic area? No ballot. Have a name that sounds Black or Hispanic? No ballot. They are not hiding what this is. It is a purge designed to look like election administration.
And that last part is particularly important. If you've been following our work, you know that in the Constitution, states have the responsibility for how elections are administered, not the federal government. This move by the USPS would give the Trump admin unprecedented power over elections and it is cartoonishly unconstitutional.
But legal challenges to this rule will likely make their way up to the Supreme Court. And that's where it gets scary--we have seen how this court has ruled lately. They have exposed themselves as complete and total puppets for Trump and MAGA extremists, willing to reverse nearly a half-century of legal precedent to tilt elections in their favor.
This is exactly why Defend Our Courts exists. We are fighting on two fronts: building a firewall of state Supreme Courts that can protect free and fair elections at the state level, and building the movement to reform a federal court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration.

This is an unprecedented assault for free and fair elections. | == This rule would effectively give the Trump admin control over who receives ballots and who doesn't. We do not have to imagine how Trump uses this power. Live in a heavily Democratic area? No ballot. Have a name that sounds Black or Hispanic? No ballot. They are not hiding what this is. It is a purge designed to look like election administration. And that last part is particularly important. If you've been following our work, you know that in the Constitution, states have the responsibility for how elections are administered, not the federal government. This move by the USPS would give the Trump admin unprecedented power over elections and it is cartoonishly unconstitutional. But legal challenges to this rule will likely make their way up to the Supreme Court. And that's where it gets scary--we have seen how this court has ruled lately. They have exposed themselves as complete and total puppets for Trump and MAGA extremists, willing to reverse nearly a half-century of legal precedent to tilt elections in their favor. This is exactly why Defend Our Courts exists. What if I told you the only reason we’ve made it this far is because of the support of thousands and thousands of people from every part of the country?
#

Friends, it's Mark.
At midnight tonight we’re going to close the books on our fundraising for May. Before that happens, I’m writing to humbly ask:
Is there anything I can say to convince you to make a donation?
What if I told you we’ve been under relentless pressure from Trump, Hegseth, and their loyalists since back in November?.
What if I told you the only reason we’ve made it this far is because of the support of thousands and thousands of people from every part of the country?

body:
Peter, a lot of people are overwhelmed right now, and I can't blame them.

Under Republican "leadership," we've watched abuse of power become routine and democratic norms treated like they're optional. And for a lot of families, _the consequences feel deeply personal:_

**Communities are being targeted by aggressive ICE raids that leave families living in fear.

Women are waking up every day wondering what rights Republicans will try to take away next.

Working families are stretching every dollar at the grocery store, struggling to keep up as costs keep rising.

People are rationing life-saving medication because they simply can't afford what they need.

At the same time, Republicans in Washington are gutting critical programs people rely on while pouring money into political vanity projects.**

_And that's not even the half of it, Peter._

I know it feels like the deck is stacked against us. But I also know this: giving up has never been an option. If we want accountability, if we want leaders who will actually fight for working people, and if we want to put a check on the chaos coming out of Washington, we have to start NOW.

Every dollar you chip in helps us keep organizing, reaching voters, and building the kind of campaign it's going to take to win back the House majority in 2026. name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Aphasia may make it harder for me to speak, but I haven’t lost my voice.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Fifteen years ago, a gunman shot me in the head while I was meeting with constituents in front of a grocery store in Tucson.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260531-1-SBase&t=1&akid=11511%2E3935704%2E0DkKNv)
Because of the damage the bullet caused to the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits, I have aphasia. This means that even though the words are in my head, I have a hard time getting them out.
**Aphasia may make it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260531-1-SBase&t=2&akid=11511%2E3935704%2E0DkKNv)
The road to recovery hasn’t been easy for me, but I’ve never given up. In addition to speech therapy and physical therapy, I dedicate much of my time to riding my bike, playing my French horn, and practicing yoga. These activities have helped me so much in my recovery journey.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260531-1-SBase&t=3&akid=11511%2E3935704%2E0DkKNv)
I know sometimes the challenge of ending gun violence in our nation can feel overwhelming. When we see the headlines after a mass shooting — or when we remember the countless tragedies that don’t make the news every day — I know how hard it can be.
But friend, we cannot give up. I have found my recovery journey and the fight to end gun violence to be very similar. **Even on the hardest days, we can never lose hope.**
We are just 24 hours away from our May fundraising deadline. Our deadlines are a critical test for the gun safety movement, as both our adversaries and our allies will be looking to see if we have the resources to take on the gun lobby and elect gun safety champions.
_So this is where I need to ask for your help:_

Peter, Something is wrong when a member of Congress treats his office like a trading desk instead of a place to represent families. Let’s go through the facts: On May 15, 2025, Congressman Rob Bresnahan sold up to $130,000 in stocks tied to health insurers like Centene, Elevance Health, UnitedHealth, and CVS Health. One week later, on May 22, he was the deciding vote for a Republican mega bill that slashed Medicaid funding by nearly $1 trillion. **Centene’s stock plunged 40% after the bill was signed into law.** That same month, on May 15, Congressman Bresnahan bought Lockheed Martin stock. On June 13, 2025, war with Iran escalated and the U.S. launched strikes on Iran. **Those market moves lined up with votes and developments that raise real questions about whose interests he is serving.** In January 2026, a report named 10 rural Pennsylvania hospitals at immediate risk of closure, in part because of the Medicaid cuts he supported.**On March 27, Bresnahan dumped up to $250,000 of Pennsylvania hospital bonds just one month after voting for the budget resolution that paved the way for those cuts.** In May 2025 he made 81 trades selling clean energy holdings and buying fossil fuel stocks in moves worth at least $200,000 and as much as $1.45 million. **Just ten days later he voted for a bill that helps big oil and hurts clean energy and working families facing higher energy bills.** This is not a one-off pattern. Bresnahan ranks as the second-most active trader this Congress. He has made over 652 trades totaling $8.48 million in volume. **The numbers speak for themselves: Bresnahan isn’t in Congress to serve us, he’s serving himself while profiting off of people’s pain.** **I ran for public office to clean up a culture of corruption and make government work for real people. That same month, on May 15, Congressman Bresnahan bought Lockheed Martin stock. On June 13, 2025, war with Iran escalated and the U.S. launched strikes on Iran. In May 2025 he made 81 trades selling clean energy holdings and buying fossil fuel stocks in moves worth at least $200,000 and as much as $1.45 million. Just ten days later he voted for a bill that helps big oil and hurts clean energy and working families facing higher energy bills. This is not a one-off pattern. |

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132435080/624499299/-1393920201?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_EOM5_260531_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OGE0OTM1NS1mZjVjLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qUmshLs3-sNfoilTlF0w_wbJjDB9T-qFYDn0sXcRha0=) Derek, we know you probably didn’t wake up this morning planning on donating to Mark Warner’s reelection campaign.

_(If for some reason you did, great! Here’s the link to give:[_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mw-email-260528-eom**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132435081/624499300/-1393920201?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_EOM5_260531_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OGE0OTM1NS1mZjVjLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qUmshLs3-sNfoilTlF0w_wbJjDB9T-qFYDn0sXcRha0=))._

And frankly, we really don’t expect you to give _every_ time we ask. We understand you hear from campaigns like ours a lot, especially ahead of big deadlines like the one we’re facing.

**But Derek, we want to explain why your donation today – before our end-of-month fundraising deadline tonight at midnight – is so critical.**

In just a few hours, this team will close the books on the month of May. From there, we’ll assess whether we hit our fundraising benchmarks, and where that leaves us for June, July, and the final few months ahead before voters head to the polls.

What we raise now determines what comes next. How many yard signs we print. How many additional organizers we can hire. How many ads we can run. How strong our ground game is in the fall, and how many voters we can get to the ballot box.

**Simply put: the resources we have _today_ matter because they determine how strong this campaign is _tomorrow_.**

There is simply too much in the line in the midterms for us to fall behind our May fundraising goal. We have a Senate seat to hold and several competitive House seats to win here in Virginia. Those races are essential if Democrats are going to flip control of Congress and put some guardrails on the corruption and cruelty we’re seeing out of the Trump administration.

Hi friend, Nikki here.

First, I want to thank you for your continued support as we move toward November. Whether you've chipped in a few bucks, joined a phone bank, knocked on doors, or told a neighbor about our campaign, every bit of it makes a difference.

**These final months will make or break control of the House – and IL-13 is part of making the Democratic majority a reality.**

When I meet with folks across Central and Southern Illinois, I see the effects of the Trump Administration's decisions firsthand. Families are being forced to choose between paying for groceries, gas, and healthcare.

The MAGA agenda isn't interested in putting working families first. Instead, they're prioritizing billionaires and using nearly _$2 BILLION_ in taxpayer money as a slush fund for Trump's biggest allies.

Corruption is running rampant. Trust in our democracy and institutions are at a low. Our opportunity to hold Trump to account is in November – with making our voices heard loud and clear at the ballot box.

This fight is essential, and I'm not backing down. If you're with me and are able to contribute before tonight's deadline, $3 would go a long way toward victory.

Dear Friend of Truth,

Are American Express and Home Depot paying for so-called "gender transitions" for minors?

The answer appears to be "yes." According to data from the far-left Human Rights Campaign, these household brands are still footing the bill for irreversible, experimental, and entirely unnecessary medical interventions for children through their parents' healthcare plans.

These kids are too young to fully understand the lifelong price they will pay--until it's too late.

That's why Alliance Defending Freedom is working alongside like-minded allies to send a message loud and clear to these powerful corporations: **American companies should not be paying for medical experimentation on confused and hurting children by covering harmful hormones and permanent, body-altering surgeries.**

You need only to hear Soren Aldaco's story to understand how sinister this is.

When Soren was 11, she was sexually groomed by an online predator, leaving her with a heavy sense of shame and self-hatred that she carried for years.

Therapists and doctors should have addressed that trauma to help her work through her feelings. Instead, they pushed her headlong into gender transition to "resolve" her struggles. They gave her cross-sex hormones and a double mastectomy that nearly took her life.

_**And her mom 's employer-sponsored healthcare plan helped pay for all of it.**_

Soren's story is a sobering reminder that these policies aren't just paperwork--they have real-life, human consequences.

As Soren told shareholders and board members at American Express, "Every company that includes these interventions in its benefits plan is a link in the chain between a confused child and an irreversible outcome."

**That 's why companies like American Express must not foot the bill for it.**

Change is possible! Thanks to your support, ADF and our allies have continued to raise this issue with companies. Earlier this year, Walmart shared its benefits plan with our allies, noting that so-called "gender-reassignment surgeries" for minors are not covered by its health insurance plan.

**Corporate America is starting to listen. Now is the moment to act.**

**Sign the petition to tell American Express and Home Depot to drop experimental "gender-transition" procedures for kids from their employee healthcare plans!**

They gave her cross-sex hormones and a double mastectomy that nearly took her life. And her mom 's employer-sponsored healthcare plan helped pay for all of it. Soren's story is a sobering reminder that these policies aren't just paperwork--they have real-life, human consequences. As Soren told shareholders and board members at American Express, "Every company that includes these interventions in its benefits plan is a link in the chain between a confused child and an irreversible outcome." That 's why companies like American Express must not foot the bill for it. Change is possible! Thanks to your support, ADF and our allies have continued to raise this issue with companies. Earlier this year, Walmart shared its benefits plan with our allies, noting that so-called "gender-reassignment surgeries" for minors are not covered by its health insurance plan. Corporate America is starting to listen. Now is the moment to act. Sign the petition to tell American Express and Home Depot to drop experimental "gender-transition" procedures for kids from their employee healthcare plans! | For truth and freedom, Jay Hobbs Director, Communications Strategy Alliance Defending Freedom P.S. | Alliance Defending Freedom 15100 N. 90th Street, Scottsdale, Arizona 85260

NYT: Trump Leans on Congress to Address His False Claims of Voter Fraud [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=053126_1&amount=25]
President Trump is trying everything his advisors can think of to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address his often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. There are stats from the conservative, right-wing Heritage Foundation below that prove it.
The SAVE America Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE AMERICA ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=053126_1&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE AMERICA Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=053126_1&amount=35]

How do we know non-citizen voting is a made up problem? Because red states and conservative-leaning institutions have spent millions in taxpayer money and donor dollars searching for it and finding minimal results.
For example: The pro-Trump Heritage Foundation -- an organization that has funded anti-voting initiatives for decades -- maintains a database of "election crimes." Their own records only list 24 instances of non-citizens voting in U.S. elections from 2003 to 2023 . In other words -- 20 years of elections, millions of votes, and only 24 alleged non-citizen voters.
Reuters has a fuller accounting in recent reporting. Florida, for example, spent millions investigating voter fraud and creating a new state department to oversee election security. They've only prosecuted two non-citizens for voting since 2022. North Carolina said they found nine non-citizens registered to vote out of 7.7 million voters. Utah recently investigated their entire voter roll of 2.1 million registered voters and found one registered non-citizen who never attempted to vote.
The conservative CATO Institute says it best: " These investigations affirm what is simply common sense. People largely aren’t willing to risk their status in the United States — the land of economic opportunity — for the ability to cast one more vote out of hundreds of thousands or millions in a state and hundreds of millions in the country. "
Team, the lies aren't going to stop, but we can push back and make sure bills like this abomination never pass. Pitch in $35 or however much you can to stand against voter suppression bills in Congress and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=053126_1&amount=35]

Hey folks, it’s Mark Kelly.
Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate.
I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.
But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something.
So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too.
I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help.
We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got the full weight of the executive branch bearing down on me right now.
After everything you’ve already done for me, I shouldn’t have to ask you for more. But that’s what I need to do.

clean_body: We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. | | | = Hey folks, it’s Mark Kelly. Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate. I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy. But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something. So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too. I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help. We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got the full weight of the executive branch bearing down on me right now. body:
What most people never see
For five years, we have done this work from temporary facilities and borrowed space, with on-the-fly logistics.

Patriot,
In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California.
**A 12-year-old girl.** _Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge._
_**Our operators physically extracted her.** _
What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been.
**And underneath all of it, faith.** Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. **We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started.** That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive.
Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team.
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – _the next child is already missing._
**This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity.**

**We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot.**
In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed:
**✅ Eight American families extracted **from Mexico in February.

**✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans** assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March.

**✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti**.

**✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations** in Virginia and West Texas this January.
The work goes back further. **64 evacuated from Ukraine** during active combat in 2022. **58 Christians rescued from persecution** across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum.
For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way.
**So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas.**
**The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism.** Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts.
**Total goal:** $1,000,000 by October.
**First milestone:** $100,000.

| |

Peter, the June 2nd primary is just days away, and our end of month fundraising deadline is tonight at midnight.

**We’re organizing until the very last minute, and what we raise in these final hours will decide whether we have the resources to finish strong.**

Scott’s self-funding opponent has already dumped nearly $10 million of his own money into this race. He’s trying to buy this seat with sheer wealth.

And now, just hours before the primary, two outside PACs have swooped in at the 11th hour - spending heavily to push one of Scott’s opponents into the lead. This is exactly the kind of last-minute outside interference we need to counter. We have to ramp up our own efforts immediately.

Scott’s campaign is powered by something different: people.

Grassroots supporters who believe San Francisco deserves a fighter for affordable housing, public transit, LGBTQ rights, and a government that actually works for us.

That’s why we need your help right now, Peter.

[**We’re still $21,505 short of our May goal, and we can’t afford to fall behind this close to Election Day. Can you rush a contribution of $10 or more now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132438829/624512713/-457569252?amount=10&refcode=SW_EM_FR_180DO_260531_1_4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDY5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YmVhYzU4YS0wMzVkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zxMbVCvPLgRTHCakGfGPB6ylI7ospD-aDkbSO3FsuKk=) _If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately._ | | ******[DONATE $10 NOW »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132438837/624512727/-1976542578?amount=10&express_lane=true&refcode=SW_EM_FR_180DO_260531_1_4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDY5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YmVhYzU4YS0wMzVkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zxMbVCvPLgRTHCakGfGPB6ylI7ospD-aDkbSO3FsuKk=)******

For decades, businesses competed for your business by offering better prices and better service. Today, too many corporations are buying influence so they don't have to compete at all. They squeeze working families at every turn, and when their bad decisions catch up with them, they know the politicians they've funded will be there with a bailout. That's corporate socialism: profits are private, but losses get dumped on the public.

Scott DesJarlais doesn't have conversations with constituents. He takes meetings with his biggest donors, gets his marching orders, and waits for the next campaign check to come. He has 14 years of corporate interests lining up to make sure he keeps voting their way and he obliges every single time.
**I don 't answer to them. I never will, but I need the resources to fight back! [Pitch in $5, $10, or $25 dollars TODAY so we can hit our goal for this month, and keep our fight alive!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6ddaa4ca-9c8e-4482-b5ec-adceda00e533?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

The system DesJarlais protects was never designed with you in mind, it was designed to keep the right people comfortable and the right donors happy while working families absorb every hit. That ends when this district sends someone to Washington who has never taken a corporate check and never will.
**Corporate socialism stops here.** The moment you send me to Washington, the lobbyists lose their seat at the table and the working class gets it back. _**Join us today!**_

My team is working every day to make sure we are ready for anything he throws, but with only a day left to hit our May goal, we need your help. Can I count on you to chip in $25 right now before the EOM Deadline?
