| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e22f15a9-720b-4c47-a273-7ad0a3bd9288?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It's graduation season, and like Spring itself, it's a time of renewal, hope, and new beginnings. It always brings back the excitement I felt decades ago, in the audience in cap and gown, my whole life ahead of me.
It's also the season of older people standing at podiums telling younger people what lies ahead and the secret sauce to living their lives. And it's no easy task for the speaker: 15 minutes to make an impact on a crowd that's hungover, sunburned, and already thinking about the after-party. They also already feel like they have all the answers - who doesn't at that age? Stated or not, there seems to be a simple rule for commencement speech success: energize the graduates and make them feel like they can take on the world.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/afb5ffda-9d76-48f7-bba3-3edcf1036f6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
But as I listened to a bunch of this year's speeches, I was struck by a recurring theme: students pushed back. It started in Orlando. On May 8, real estate executive Gloria Caulfield stood before the graduating class of UCF's [College of Arts and Humanities](https://substack.com/redirect/9460b6c3-e1c0-4080-9c24-00829d4f54f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and called artificial intelligence "the next industrial revolution." **The students booed.** Not a polite murmur. A sustained roar that continued to get louder until Caulfield stopped, turned to the administrators, and asked, "What happened?"
She tried to recover: "Only a few years ago, AI was not a factor in our lives" and **the crowd cheered** ... but as she continued, "and now, AI capabilities are in the palm of our hands..." **[the boos resumed](https://substack.com/redirect/4f5c8c3d-dfdf-4bdd-826f-ae0b57c58c01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. One graduate, Ethan Lubin, [told the ](https://substack.com/redirect/e1d5df3e-845f-4b68-b2d3-737e98c66a20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/e1d5df3e-845f-4b68-b2d3-737e98c66a20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ : "Talking about artificial intelligence at a college for arts and humanities can be, you know, a bit rough, because it kind of goes against the humanities part."
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b34987d9-a79b-4b31-8b6c-19a667504a82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The next day, it happened again. At Middle Tennessee State University, [Scott Borchetta](https://substack.com/redirect/0e92887a-3f6a-49b0-949a-76967ae3e76f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the Big Machine Records CEO best known as Taylor Swift's adversary, told graduates that "AI is rewriting production as we sit here." **More boos**.
His response: ["Deal with it,"](https://substack.com/redirect/9460b6c3-e1c0-4080-9c24-00829d4f54f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) followed by: "Then do something about it. It's a tool. Make it work for you." Then he told them what they'd learned in college was **" already obsolete."** A man worth $450 million telling students with six-figure debt that their education is worthless. [Gizmodo's verdict](https://substack.com/redirect/0e92887a-3f6a-49b0-949a-76967ae3e76f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "Perhaps not well-suited to the job of inspiring young people."
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5d68bf07-2270-4c0f-9487-2af094ba6788?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A week later, former Google CEO Eric Schmidt [got the same treatment at the University of Arizona](https://substack.com/redirect/1e018a1d-d451-4f18-8d9a-5e1bbbea7e0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). As soon as he mentioned AI, the crowd reacted. Schmidt, to his credit, stopped and said: "I can hear you. There is a fear in your generation that the future has already been written, that the machines are coming, that the jobs are evaporating, that the climate is breaking, that politics are fractured, and that you are inheriting a mess that you did not create." It might have been the most honest thing said by anyone this commencement season. It was also an admission, from a man worth $30 billion, that those who built these technologies understand the fear they've created among the next generation.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/7255caf3-9fe7-42d2-9afb-d953bd5cc6e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[TechCrunch's headline](https://substack.com/redirect/1c6fe93c-7642-412c-a93e-a1553a7ddf26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) summarized the lesson to be drawn from these speeches: "If you're giving a commencement speech in 2026, maybe don't mention AI."
The reaction of graduates shouldn't be surprising. The pushback against artificial intelligence is a reflection of society's worries. A [Pew Research survey](https://substack.com/redirect/4f5c8c3d-dfdf-4bdd-826f-ae0b57c58c01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) found half of Americans are more concerned than excited about AI. And [a Gallup report](https://substack.com/redirect/4f5c8c3d-dfdf-4bdd-826f-ae0b57c58c01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) says the mood is getting worse, not better. Hope is giving way to anxiety and, in some extreme cases, anger.
Think about this from the graduates' perspective. They were told to go to college. They did. They were told to learn skills the economy values. They did. Many of them took on mountains of debt to do so. And now they're listening to people who are making gazillions from this revolution tell them the very skills they just spent four years acquiring are being automated...and it'll make the future better. The boos are not just anti-technology. They're also anti-hypocrisy.
* * *
## [AI's Brave New World](https://substack.com/redirect/627d18dd-f51d-406b-b7fd-23c5b52d845e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [Vikram Mansharamani](https://substack.com/profile/37278065-vikram-mansharamani)| | *
---|---|---
| Feb 22
[](https://substack.com/redirect/627d18dd-f51d-406b-b7fd-23c5b52d845e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Last week I wrote about why AI keeps me up at night. This week, I want to explain why it also gets me out of bed in the morning. I've always felt that successfully navigating uncertainty requires consideration of multiple perspectives and since last week was about worries, it's now time to explore the upside of AI.](https://substack.com/redirect/627d18dd-f51d-406b-b7fd-23c5b52d845e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/627d18dd-f51d-406b-b7fd-23c5b52d845e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
I've written a lot about AI over the past year, focusing on both risks and opportunities emerging from the technology. But watching students boo speakers created a new perspective on the topic for me. I realized today's youth aren't Luddites smashing looms. They are kids who grew up with technology, whose entire lives have been videoed and shared with the world; they use ChatGPT to write papers and Claude to debug code. **They 're not afraid of AI because they don't understand it. They're afraid because they **_**do**_.
The people making money from these technological advances tell them that the future is bright and are confused by people who think otherwise. Somebody is wrong, and I'm not sure it's the kids in the audience.
* * *
## [AI-Generated Unemployment](https://substack.com/redirect/4f3c2dad-ada1-4b11-aa45-6ae8ad9202f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [Vikram Mansharamani](https://substack.com/profile/37278065-vikram-mansharamani)| | *
---|---|---
| Mar 23
[](https://substack.com/redirect/4f3c2dad-ada1-4b11-aa45-6ae8ad9202f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[There has been a lot written lately about AI's impact on the economy, specifically how many jobs it will eliminate. And that's really only one of the many risks that will accompany the massive advancements in information processing capabilities that AI is empowering.](https://substack.com/redirect/4f3c2dad-ada1-4b11-aa45-6ae8ad9202f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/4f3c2dad-ada1-4b11-aa45-6ae8ad9202f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Not every commencement speaker this season got booed. Country singer Eric Church gave what's being called ["one of the best commencement speeches ever"](https://substack.com/redirect/f3862fd6-92f7-46fc-93d9-915821f196a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the University of North Carolina. He didn't mention AI once. Instead, he strummed his guitar and used its six strings as metaphors for [faith, family, partnership, ambition, community, and individuality](https://substack.com/redirect/0680757a-c691-4b8c-80db-be9c23a548a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He closed by telling graduates: "The world does not need another cover song. It needs an original." Then he played "Carolina" and rows of students in blue caps swayed arm in arm. Millions viewed online.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/05b1b35d-a3c2-4638-b038-21402ad17a72?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
His speech worked because he talked _**to**_ the graduates, not _**at**_ them. In this swirling world of change and chaos he told them to ground themselves in old-fashioned values that are just as relevant now as they were for our grandparents.
In a time when students are wondering if being human is enough, Church offered them something deeply human. And at least for now, it sure seems like humans value humans.

As we head toward a massive quarterly deadline next month, the national spotlight is shining brighter than ever on our home state. # [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132454330/624563266/-664395954?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODA1NDE1OS0yYjVkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hLhSLGEDEMEhz_7z3MT4j1UwFjAZQF2n6L_v5DVwjQA=)
Hi friend — Chelsey Wininger here. I want to tell you about something that happened a few weeks ago that I haven't been able to stop thinking about. **An FBI agent showed up at the home — not the office, the home — of Milwaukee County's elections director. They didn't call or go through official channels. They arrived at her front door.** This is just one example of the Trump administration's ongoing campaign to intimidate the election officials who stood between Trump and the results he wanted in 2020. Milwaukee County. Wayne County, Michigan. Fulton County, Georgia. The FBI has visited homes, seized ballots, and pursued election records — in the exact states and counties that were decisive in delivering the 2020 defeat to Donald Trump. **And every single one of them is on our 2026 battleground map.** Wisconsin is an open seat we are fighting to keep blue. So is Michigan, where Democrat Garlin Gilchrist is running in a race we cannot afford to lose. clean_body: We need your help to defend democracy during this urgent moment | Peter, When Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry declared a state of emergency and suspended his state’s primary elections in order to redraw their congressional map, it meant that 45,000 ballots would be discarded. When the Virginia Supreme Court invalidated the results of a ballot initiative to approve the state’s new map, the ruling silenced 3 million Virginians. In Alabama, after the Supreme Court gave them permission to revisit their map, officials shut down an ongoing primary election and tried to ignore the ballots already cast by thousands of voters. It’s a disturbing trend. Republicans are willing to do the once unthinkable — throwing out already-cast ballots — in order to maintain their grip on power. And this is just the beginning. These anti-democracy attacks will only get worse if we don't mount a fierce opposition to stop this ominous trend in its tracks. | | **The economy should work for everyone. But right now, too many hardworking people in Northwest Washington are doing everything right and still struggling to make ends meet.** I have heard from countless hard-working people trying to balance full-time jobs and the cost of child care. They are putting off home repairs, medical appointments, and family vacations because there is simply not enough left over at the end of the month. And we are _all_ watching grocery bills and gas prices climb higher each month. That is not the kind of economy working families need. **I believe that a good job is more than a paycheck. It is a source of dignity. It is the ability to provide for your family, plan for the future, and enjoy a good quality of life.** That is why my top priority in Congress is bringing economic investments to Northwest Washington that create good-paying jobs and strengthen our communities. **I am proud to have delivered $386 million from the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law to Washington's Second District to modernize roads, ferries, ports, and other critical infrastructure while creating jobs that support local families — but we need to do more.** We need to raise the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour. We need to guarantee equal pay for equal work. We need to invest in skills training for workers and young people. And we need to strengthen unions, so workers have the power to negotiate for better pay, better benefits, and safer workplaces. At the same time, billionaires and special interests are spending enormous sums to protect a system that works very well for them. **They see campaign contributions as an investment in preserving tax breaks and loopholes while working families are asked to settle for less.** I do not believe Northwest Washington should be represented by those interests. I believe our government should fight to lower costs, raise wages, and improve the quality of life for every family in our local communities. 2 years ago I ran for the position of President of the IDCCA for one reason, team: Because Democratic success in Illinois is earned, not guaranteed.

There’s no such thing as a “red state” or a “blue state”. We’ve spent a lot of time, energy, and elbow grease to keep Democrats here in Illinois engaged and voting for our values – and I won’t take their votes for granted.

The only way to ensure repeated Democratic victories in our state is to continue organizing for our candidates at every level of the ballot.

This work isn’t always easy. It isn’t always publicized, and it certainly isn’t always glamorous. But it does make a difference. subject: What it takes to be that team is what most people never see

body:
45 agonizing days under a bridge
For five years, we have done this work from temporary facilities and borrowed space, with on-the-fly logistics.

| | | | | |
---
[ ](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=e32ffc97144b4beea3aeff79f6309e67&_e=Tu5Ubm0mm_jqi0IcNZQJx9HhFXl6cNJ392LDxXaaZlcX-7fJ1m_6E0wOG4oN--_QiMc9Bbiyeeajf9U1i1qftjPIPD2icu7R-hc0BW0EFSyeZPWSMGOf4O1wVqVUH717uZmIfRae_HuD9UNU9jMICyf3mAbJ1y396yIIB4NhhRcdFcQRO_VY6VRccDLAm9rKAWZGRyPjGI9b0Vkn_GrAh_8EIymVxG6gj6PZxW8j34Cq7TcOQ98-Dwxb5J9oNL0G6MCacHWW7yT28Ish0nKnfDImgM6NDA5X0G4leGRWPRW2IxpTKPfy8UoVPNNJeUZD5vF5T6fIBrMRXxgmZaUAp3_ozkoaAOkZV1x4SVqEwGHalYN0d7p6As_yPHe1vTAFzhKz9yVQO8WhpSXzWCGkv6Z6IQWetc_lNbf35IrlTR41ly_PQAo-5bdvpEawTOLk-ZcclCxXauHcVhqh1llQNux_LOrbzqPDCbfSGYj-AdAbZ3aMh7B42Vc7bjHU11TxC1PshalP4q4T-y2eh5njgweMZUQgndsywW4ogJvfbfM-t8D8cf7leZ4jgRqKBRKVC8f6y1fryVwL9xG8DWSTmbDBKk4fuDHKaMOsoBwjrHNEEMuRw8Ba01_ZsB13x3tJFbAzVE-1VU_bC_7gTw6x7XBrlGTLG1VEFq1n8YyVHJ8Jg5oGUtlvjza-yLrZgx-8QKR7X2lKAXj9wVkTVwTwe4rBbYVYE88QWc8aYzyWwAAgLJqXpsimu2DVRsbFi-mCRmJKghEeT2-MvtaFPucvlaiKd7QSJy51ldqy-bWt9979XFgFqAz4Mgp6QCr90aEr)
---
Peter,
In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California.
**A 12-year-old girl.** _Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge._
_**Our operators physically extracted her.** _
What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been.
**And underneath all of it, faith.** Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. **We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started.** That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive.
Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team.
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – _the next child is already missing._
**This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity.**
---
[ ](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=e32ffc97144b4beea3aeff79f6309e67&_e=Tu5Ubm0mm_jqi0IcNZQJx9HhFXl6cNJ392LDxXaaZlcX-7fJ1m_6E0wOG4oN--_QiMc9Bbiyeeajf9U1i1qftjPIPD2icu7R-hc0BW0EFSyeZPWSMGOf4O1wVqVUH717uZmIfRae_HuD9UNU9jMICyf3mAbJ1y396yIIB4NhhRcdFcQRO_VY6VRccDLAm9rKAWZGRyPjGI9b0Vkn_GrAh_8EIymVxG6gj6PZxW8j34Cq7TcOQ98-Dwxb5J9oNL0G6MCacHWW7yT28Ish0nKnfDImgM6NDA5X0G4leGRWPRUkf-fWvKymapk16j6uUNQftwq6kbYU6znhKOW47iRISnutoFKh0-Sw56M1bFc0c_5K4QwyjwVjs9cTu8qfjSDJ86lWqLIhD5jTbwUoaxt2mdL9DPVx6jGxCDNwfUpVC__BYqtXdOLVIDUINY1d8u_XwyU3Q5rEU7oLv65YhLJt6vrBuD2GGTgRvP6BtFeQZ5XEKRv-KBmVeXSbdBKOTg83dHeOD50vNMOW16Ot3FAa46u1MYz2h0qfasZ9TeXz6NdH8d0vFR1RadYklVHT3-rV7sMTa0SIjK2m42IRYjPR42a1-I10K2_V2h-BUvDl6DqkuYuxmFypcbXxSQ7FfN3n8BCR_djptkr22Myt0a2LMikqVSoAASVcFsIdIud0AUpvlCtiKltey1gqEgIu4IeHehYkjM57VOEQ3gTF5u4UFxmSo8-071aqhkzmkVhIGuvwP-9WhbX6doCoXRHtAuMFZiVbDENFBjxZ7dsfPe_E-PDvz1hnzfVeqhB0JKal4wrAmSF6aU4VCIcrErkT057g)
---
**We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot.**
In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed:
**✅ Eight American families extracted **from Mexico in February.

**✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans** assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March.

**✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti**.

**✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations** in Virginia and West Texas this January.
The work goes back further. **64 evacuated from Ukraine** during active combat in 2022. **58 Christians rescued from persecution** across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum.
For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way.
**So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas.**
**The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism.** Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts.
**Total goal:** $1,000,000 by October.
**First milestone:** $100,000.
[ **Your generous commitment, right now, with a donation of any amount would be incredibly helpful. The strength of this launch will set the tone for our push towards October, and anything you can afford, even if it’s just $25, would be a true blessing.** ](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=e32ffc97144b4beea3aeff79f6309e67&_e=Tu5Ubm0mm_jqi0IcNZQJx9HhFXl6cNJ392LDxXaaZlcX-7fJ1m_6E0wOG4oN--_QiMc9Bbiyeeajf9U1i1qftjPIPD2icu7R-hc0BW0EFSyeZPWSMGOf4O1wVqVUH717uZmIfRae_HuD9UNU9jMICyf3mAbJ1y396yIIB4NhhRcdFcQRO_VY6VRccDLAm9rKAWZGRyPjGI9b0Vkn_GrAh_8EIymVxG6gj6PZxW8j34Cq7TcOQ98-Dwxb5J9oNL0G6MCacHWW7yT28Ish0nKnfDImgM6NDA5X0G4leGRWPRWSsIZLygfsX8F9WIURB8RHYc__8tbWtWNF3J2ARt-sCK-N_waC7bdCwIoKEt4fCMvjSHLh7BvgADCEblASHlCw_zOeLHLwFMB8-xH257THxgehigIi_EtFvYwbQNeXXnW5AjJlHh7YH8wjaq4hjkMCx_a-kjBMSROBwQtDzSAII4oUZoxrhXCWQQDSM2H4J87uoxgopxEZ3_2ZD_RH3auMJebg_oS33hRXIQYVtbLl5bYDdiIc69A0eUrManruQ6pNNb1AAxKiuz88niAgD2_vdoNK7y4qtFS_rpQ5nFhzfwpkSwNWKZTGoMpKfzEfsBhVDLs0x6mUGWouJSRdT1WrzHDzaZnsBNqOSLpDUKdQMzAyKYNz9M989pQvaho6XqbOE1S98uCkOKhLEVFgY5tLlPiTcip7n-nZLJ0MsKnWT82a2mpVlMD82vyVFu_Mdn8aUBqelrS1StTPxkFSZhip3eFTZvJwYrLkEdVMaKFZy65eg_nsyVA36uv6TpwswOMzR9KlRf2DLvOvzdvuzPT_)

**As we approach Memorial Day, I would be remiss to not highlight a central piece of the facility, our Foundational Wall** – our way of honoring those who've served, and other heroes among us who deserve our gratitude. **For gifts of $1,000 or more, you can dedicate a brick in honor of someone you choose.** For service members, information will include name, unit, branch, birth and end dates. For non-service members, information may include personal details and attributes, “in loving memory of,” and birth and end dates.
**While that 12-year-old girl in California is now safe, countless other missing children are already out there.** Please, help us build the place that prepares our operators to go find, and bring them home.
Thank you, and let's never forget our mission – _to free the oppressed, so others may live._
Respectfully submitted,
Dennis Price
Founder & CEO
Heroes for Humanity

**First,** everyone from _The New York Times_ to _CNN_ reported that Ohio is in play, calling it one of the most important races in the country.
**Then,** we started gaining ground, with poll after poll showing me statistically tied with Republican Jon Husted.
**Now,** Husted and the GOP are terrified we’re going to flip this seat and the Senate, so their PACs are pouring a combined $81 million into this race to pummel me with attacks.
Peter, we have an opportunity in Ohio to give working people the fighter they deserve – but National Republicans are spending more here than anywhere else in the country. **The only way I can fight back against this onslaught of attacks and dark money is with your critical grassroots support.**

name: Dennis Price, Heroes for Humanity
subject: She was trafficked for 45 days before we got her home
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heroes for Humanity
body:
In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California.

For five years, we have done this work from temporary facilities and borrowed space, with on-the-fly logistics.
| | | | | |
---
[ ](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL2q3DAQRp9G7rzoZ2V7CxeBZSHFTXOLlGYsjewhsiSkcS779sGQvEDaw-GD8_38WD6AIqXtBxw4U2tLbUvb8QsaVwiB3C_0Ide79fBui5Z66KXtjVpKza2g40V1frZaTWHqcFbjJPUgzTB1--ynx-rNJK0fIahxfEyrtdaFIL16DNp0NF-D0hql5X2Q9qbDCgGM8quF0ayjuMuzeGC8UWrksbmcS8mRmFy75bp1cd6ZSxPmm9AvoV8-p0vnHXesGVvIdT8PSMTvyxf6lYApJ4g9V6BEaesdJsbaRziT2_u258pL6UsuwrwqurNWSpswT64nCj2cfCzshHl-__zs_wX85S4nxsTCPPEAiqqrsy9fFCO14arZLnpz-ej4f9_-Pes_AQAA__9TkJNE)
---
Friend,
In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California.
**A 12-year-old girl.** _Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge._
_**Our operators physically extracted her.** _
What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been.
**And underneath all of it, faith.** Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. **We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started.** That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive.
Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team.
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – _the next child is already missing._
**This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity.**
---
[ ](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL2q3DAQRp9G7rzoZ2V7CxeBZSHFTXOLlGYsjewhsiSkcS779sGQvEDaw-GD8_38WD6AIqXtBxw4U2tLbUvb8QsaVwiB3C_0Ide79fBui5Z66KXtjVpKza2g40V1frZaTWHqcFbjJPUgzTB1--ynx-rNJK0fIahxfEyrtdaFIL16DNp0NF-D0hql5X2Q9qbDCgGM8quF0ayjuMuzeGC8UWrksbmcS8mRmFy75bp1cd6ZSxPmm9AvoV8-p0vnHXesGVvIdT8PSMTvyxf6lYApJ4g9V6BEaesdJsbaRziT2_u258pL6UsuwrwqurNWSpswT64nCj2cfCzshHl-__zs_wX85S4nxsTCPPEAiqqrsy9fFCO14arZLnpz-ej4f9_-Pes_AQAA__9TkJNE)
---
**We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot.**
In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed:
**✅ Eight American families extracted **from Mexico in February.

**✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans** assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March.

**✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti**.

**✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations** in Virginia and West Texas this January.
The work goes back further. **64 evacuated from Ukraine** during active combat in 2022. **58 Christians rescued from persecution** across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum.
For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way.
**So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas.**
**The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism.** Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts.
**Total goal:** $1,000,000 by October.
**First milestone:** $100,000.
[ **Your generous commitment, right now, with a donation of any amount would be incredibly helpful. The strength of this launch will set the tone for our push towards October, and anything you can afford, even if it’s just $25, would be a true blessing.** ](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL2q3DAQRp9G7rzoZ2V7CxeBZSHFTXOLlGYsjewhsiSkcS779sGQvEDaw-GD8_38WD6AIqXtBxw4U2tLbUvb8QsaVwiB3C_0Ide79fBui5Z66KXtjVpKza2g40V1frZaTWHqcFbjJPUgzTB1--ynx-rNJK0fIahxfEyrtdaFIL16DNp0NF-D0hql5X2Q9qbDCgGM8quF0ayjuMuzeGC8UWrksbmcS8mRmFy75bp1cd6ZSxPmm9AvoV8-p0vnHXesGVvIdT8PSMTvyxf6lYApJ4g9V6BEaesdJsbaRziT2_u258pL6UsuwrwqurNWSpswT64nCj2cfCzshHl-__zs_wX85S4nxsTCPPEAiqqrsy9fFCO14arZLnpz-ej4f9_-Pes_AQAA__9TkJNE)
---
| [MAKE A GIFT TODAY](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL2q3DAQRp9G7rzoZ2V7CxeBZSHFTXOLlGYsjewhsiSkcS779sGQvEDaw-GD8_38WD6AIqXtBxw4U2tLbUvb8QsaVwiB3C_0Ide79fBui5Z66KXtjVpKza2g40V1frZaTWHqcFbjJPUgzTB1--ynx-rNJK0fIahxfEyrtdaFIL16DNp0NF-D0hql5X2Q9qbDCgGM8quF0ayjuMuzeGC8UWrksbmcS8mRmFy75bp1cd6ZSxPmm9AvoV8-p0vnHXesGVvIdT8PSMTvyxf6lYApJ4g9V6BEaesdJsbaRziT2_u258pL6UsuwrwqurNWSpswT64nCj2cfCzshHl-__zs_wX85S4nxsTCPPEAiqqrsy9fFCO14arZLnpz-ej4f9_-Pes_AQAA__9TkJNE "MAKE A GIFT TODAY")
---
**Additionally, I would be remiss to not highlight a central piece of the facility, our Foundational Wall** – our way of honoring those who've served, and other heroes among us who deserve our gratitude. **For gifts of $1,000 or more, you can dedicate a brick in honor of someone you choose.** For service members, information will include name, unit, branch, birth and end dates. For non-service members, information may include personal details and attributes, “in loving memory of,” and birth and end dates.
**While that 12-year-old girl in California is now safe, countless other missing children are already out there.** Please, help us build the place that prepares our operators to go find, and bring them home.
Thank you, and let's never forget our mission – _to free the oppressed, so others may live._
Respectfully submitted,
Dennis Price
Founder & CEO
Heroes for Humanity

So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas. The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism. Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts. Total goal: $1,000,000 by October. First milestone: $100,000. | "MAKE A GIFT TODAY" Additionally, I would be remiss to not highlight a central piece of the facility, our Foundational Wall – our way of honoring those who've served, and other heroes among us who deserve our gratitude. For gifts of $1,000 or more, you can dedicate a brick in honor of someone you choose. For service members, information will include name, unit, branch, birth and end dates. For non-service members, information may include personal details and attributes, “in loving memory of,” and birth and end dates. While that 12-year-old girl in California is now safe, countless other missing children are already out there. Please, help us build the place that prepares our operators to go find, and bring them home. Thank you, and let's never forget our mission – to free the oppressed, so others may live. Respectfully submitted, Dennis Price Founder & CEO Heroes for Humanity | | | | "PLEASE DONATE" | | | | | SERVING THE VULNERABLE. SHARING THE GOSPEL. Let’s talk about why this campaign matters so much.

Hey,
I know your inbox must be flooded with end-of-month, hair-on-fire emails, so I'll get straight to the point.
The latest polling is crystal clear: I am the Democrat best positioned to beat Mike Rogers in November.
Trump endorsed Rogers, MAGA money is pouring into Michigan and the Republican machine is going to throw everything they have at whoever comes out of our primary in August.
Don't think I haven't done this before. In 2018, I flipped a seat that Democrats were told was too red to bother with. I beat the incumbent by 4 points. When people told me I didn’t have a chance, I went out and proved them wrong.

Here's the deal, team: Voter registration work happens all year long, not just in the summer and through the lead-in to the deadlines ahead of Election Day.
There's no better way to defend our fundamental right to vote than by registering a ton of new voters and winning critical local, state, and federal elections. Our access to the ballot -- from vote-by-mail to drop boxes to early voting and more -- depends on being able to pass laws that are pro-voter, not pro-incumbent politician.
As little as $3 supports our work to register a new voter. Please, RUSH $30 or more right now to help us register 10 new voters to fight back at the polls >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=053126_3&amount=30]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
MS NOW: ‘The largest investment ever’: DNC launches voter registration drive [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=053126_3&amount=30]
The 2025 elections showed us a valuable truth, folks: Voter participation is increasing in all the right ways.
Voter registration activity increased across the country. According to the team at National Voter Registration Day, New York recorded more registrations for their 2025 events than in 2024, and California saw similar increases. Earlier this fall it looked like voter participation was going to make a real jump, even in a so-called "off-year".
Then Election Day came. New Jersey had more voters turn out for a gubernatorial election than they had in 20 years. Crucial counties in Pennsylvania saw their highest turnout levels in almost 15 years. New York City reached a turnout percentage unseen in over five decades.
We can drive even higher levels of participation when voters understand the stakes and feel like their vote matters , just like it did last November. That's why our voter registration efforts are so important, and why we work on it all year long.
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you step up with $30 or more today to help register 10 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=053126_3&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=053126_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=053126_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=053126_3&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=053126_3&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=053126_3&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=053126_3&amount=36]
The key is getting young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights across the country -- to see the importance of voting now more than ever. Pundits in Virginia said they could have called the election results when they saw the first turnout numbers from the major college campus locations around the state. That's the kind of impact these young voters can have.
Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
The upcoming midterm election will determine whether our democracy stays mired in the darkness and conspiracy theories we hear every day or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and march forward to a better future.
New voter registration -- at a cost to us of just about $3 per new voter -- can be game-changing. Can you pitch in with $30 or however much you can to help us register a tidal wave of new voters ahead of this year's voter registration deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=053126_3&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=053126_3&amount=20]

# [Proud to Fight for Equality in Gettysburg!](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/05/31/proud-to-fight-for-equality-in-gettysburg/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on May 31, 2026
---
| **District Round-up 05.31.26**
---
Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here:**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beth-farnham-for-congress-1](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=83ae72fc866adb0cd81b87ff67b3171b463519087a84f72ffee3976b96bafaa3&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7666&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=b44a149c544080423b132968205f9a3e&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JldGgtZmFybmhhbS1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MtMQ=&email_id=d859fa0c771edfb6ac7c35c3169e6159)**
---
| **All Gave Some, But Some Gave All**
---
|
My paternal grandfather|
My paternal great-uncle|
Yours truly on the Gettysburg Battlefield
---|---|---
On Monday, we remembered the Fallen in service to America.
---
May we never forsake the sacrifices they made for the freedoms we cherish today.
---
My paternal grandfather, Captain Wesley Yeo Clement (USAF) and my paternal great uncle, Lieutenant Harrison Robins III (USAAF), both died in service.
---
My grandfather was occupying Germany when his plane suffered a midair collision in 1953 and my great uncle was shot parachuting over Japan in 1944.
---
Both gave their all for Democracy – that The United States never be taken over by fascism, nor hostile regimes, that our power to vote remain sacred.
---
Their sacrifices were not in vain, but to continue to honor them we must[ #ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=ce83a9b4e2a7e9cd284ed1be8a1f06f2771d35e6c8334dd7a225cfcfd94780a9&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7666&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=b14a43ac1005b8e4592df55e585cbe9d&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=d859fa0c771edfb6ac7c35c3169e6159)!
---
(Many thanks to Gettysburg Rising for having a demonstration for our national parks at the Eternal Peace Light Memorial on the Gettysburg Battlefield on Sunday and to Team Member Sue Oberman for taking the picture.)
---
| **Come to my FUN-draiser on June 7th!**
---
Come One, Come All to my FUNdraiser in Gettysburg on June 7th at Reid’s Winery and Cider House from 4pm – 6pm!
---
For $30 a person or $250 a table for 6 guests, you can relax and enjoy sangria and light fare, listen to live music provided by Voices Three, bid in a silent auction that includes:
---
a stay at a Rehoboth Beach getaway,
---
a stay at historic Lane House in Mercersburg,
---
a simple will writing by local lawyer, Jeff Cook,
---
a dozen bottles of wine,
---
tickets to Hershey Theatre,
---
and more!
---
Proceeds benefit Beth Farnham for Congress.
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy!
---
Get your tickets here: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gettysburgjune7th](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=d25953b5ef550a76df37ea65682779700335f2367bd7390396f437e4a6376527&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7666&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=99cc343e14e0ed72e32b2befb859a76a&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2dldHR5c2J1cmdqdW5lN3Ro&email_id=d859fa0c771edfb6ac7c35c3169e6159)
---
| |
---
| | **Abolish I.C.E. Pledge**
---
One of the rights I cherish as an American citizen is the right of DUE PROCESS (having a warrant signed by a judge, etc.), granted by the 5th Amendment.
---
Fifth Amendment:
---
**No person** shall be held to answer for a capital, or otherwise infamous crime, unless on a presentment or indictment of a Grand Jury, except in cases arising in the land or naval forces, or in the Militia, when in actual service in time of War or public danger; nor shall any person be subject for the same offence to be twice put in jeopardy of life or limb; nor shall be compelled in any criminal case to be a witness against himself, nor be deprived of life, liberty, or property, **without** **due process** of law; nor shall private property be taken for public use, without just compensation.
---
And the Fifth Amendment applies to ALL ON U.S. SOIL.
---
“The Fifth Amendment’s Due Process Clause protects all persons within U.S. territory, including corporations, aliens, and, presumptively, citizens seeking readmission to the United States.” – (Constitution website noted in comments)
---
In other words, if you are on US soil as an undocumented immigrant, you are under US jurisdiction, which means you are under Equal Protection of the the Law and that means...DUE PROCESS.
---
However, Immigration Customs and Enforcement (I.C.E.) is violating that law, both by kidnapping people without due process at all and falsely claiming that undocumented immigrants aren’t entitled to due process.
---
And because they are violating the constitutional law and our rights, they are snatching American citizens off the streets, even when the citizens provide the correct identification papers.
---
“The young mother of four, who is Spanish-speaking, was already anxious as she approached the checkpoint that morning, because her baby daughter was spiking a high fever. At the agents’ request, she showed her ID and social security card. But they called it fake, and she was detained, handcuffed, shackled at the ankles, interrogated, and ultimately transported to South Louisiana ICE Processing Center in Basile. ICE held here there for about five hours, away from her sick child, and released the woman around 2 a.m. after a lawyer intervened on her behalf.”
---
I am here to say that it is NEVER worth Americans losing our precious freedoms for I.C.E. to round up undocumented immigrants, on whose labor and payment of local, state, federal, and sales taxes we rely.
---
If you choose to give up your freedom to walk the streets, then I suggest you take yourself to an I.C.E. detention center now because if they keep getting away with this Gestapo behavior, it will only be a matter of time that they come for you under other pretenses.
---
This is why I am proud to sign the Abolish I.C.E. pledge and I hope you will join me. When elected to Congress, I will gladly support expansion of immigration courts, community safety, and expanded pathways to citizenship so that we can streamline the process and help new generations find their piece of the American Dream.

| **Children Are Not Their Parents’ Property**
---
| |
---
They are thinking human beings full of curiosity, heartfelt sentiments, and developing independence.
---
While parents are absolutely responsible for them, there can be tension as children grow into adults and their caregivers accept their independence.
---
But it is a process, not a switch, and so parents learn to let go a little at a time.
---
One of the ways children can assert themselves is to tell others what they prefer to be called.
---
This happened with a close family member of mine, in fact.
---
Most of his life, he had spent with a nickname, like “Davy” short for David. However, in a new school and living situation, he reverted to his first name, something like Thurston.
---
I kept checking in with him because I had known him as Davy, but I was willing to call him by his new name if that was what he preferred. No, he responded to my frequent inquiries, he was fine with the family still calling him Davy, so we did. And the people newer in his life called him Thurston, but we all understood we were talking about the same person who had initiated the request in the first place.
---
AND IT WASN’T A BIG DEAL.
---
If he had said, “I’m a girl, call me Margaret,” I would have been surprised, but again, it wouldn’t have been A BIG DEAL.
---
Yet, just a few weeks ago, the U.S. House of Representatives passed HR 2616, poorly named, the “Stopping Indoctrination and Protecting Kids Act” which PREVENTS FEDERAL FUNDING TO SCHOOLS THAT ALLOW CHILDREN’S PREFERRED NAMES AND GENDERS TO BE USED ON SCHOOL FORMS.
---
First of all, there aren’t that many children who choose names beyond what their parents call them.
---
Second, there are even fewer children who are born of one sex, but present differently.
---
Third, if the parents don’t know their child’s preferred name and/or gender, there might be hostile reasons for that. Why should the student bury their emerging identity at school to appease people who tell them they won’t love them if those same children express who they are?
---
Fourth, and this takes the minds of people who aren’t pedophiles to understand, THERE IS NO INDOCTRINATION. Teachers accepting the name and gender preferences of students are NOT telling them what and who to be, they’re accepting what the children asserted FOR THEMSELVES and that is a huge difference.
---
Fifth, it is unconscionable that anyone would allow this bill to go through, threatening to WITHHOLD FEDERAL FUNDING to ALL PUBLIC STUDENTS of that school simply because the school supports the emerging identities of students.
---
Sixth, legislators like our own U.S. Representative, elitist multimillionaire John Joyce, are far too excited to vote on a bill about the gender policing of minor children then they are about releasing the Epstein files and it’s GROSS. Remember, Joyce never signed the petition to force the vote to the House floor and he only voted to release them after Trump okayed it. Now he is perfectly silent about not all the files having been released, that the Epstein victims are named in the report, not redacted, and the names of alleged abusers are redacted. Meanwhile, he says nothing about the Louisiana representative, where child marriage is still legal, voting against releasing the Epstein files. EWWW.
---
Seventh, if we want to be honest, it’s not trans students who sexually assault female students in Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it’s straight, older, white men, exactly the people who are trying to make Everyday Americans look anywhere else but at the sex crimes of THEIR DEMOGRAPHIC.
---
Eighth, if a child is so very insistent about being recognized as the opposite sex, then responsible parents do not seek surgery for that child, but work with licensed pediatricians to prescribe puberty blockers which are safe medications (supported by the American Academy of Pediatrics) that prevent the child from going through a permanent puberty until the child reaches the age of majority to make that decision for themself.
---
Make no mistake, the members of the Epstein class in Congress do not actually care about children, they care about POWER. And when they give absolute POWER to parents over children, they get votes, as well as a continuation of the philosophy that there is a hierarchy of existence, of which they find themselves at the top.
---
But it doesn’t have to be this way.
---
Children can express who they are at school. If their actions and words are not actively harming anyone, let their voices be heard.
---
I am fighting for LGBTQ+ rights, including those of minor children, because I recognize them as fully human and our Democracy depends on recognizing ALL members of society. Additionally, OUR tax dollars should never be withheld from public school funding because a few religious zealots want to be sure about what genitals children have based on their names or presented gender.
---
Let’s remove the Epstein class members from Congress.
---
Please vote for me on November 3rd and[ #ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=aea5d4972fb655c1b17619335882161778df283c056866dd4c16ab2447c590dc&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7666&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=868cbd5ec30f741aa64face4a2d5dfc7&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=d859fa0c771edfb6ac7c35c3169e6159)!
---
FYI, I’m attaching a gallery of screenshots of news articles about those who have actually been accused of, charged with, convicted of, and/or imprisoned for sexually assaulting girls and women in our 13th Congressional District – mostly straight, white, males – NOT trans youth.

---

---

---
I fight for our precious Democracy because I love my country.
---
I fight for Reproductive Freedom because I believe in agency over our own bodies and creating the families that we choose.
---
I believe that Everyday Americans deserve Life, Liberty, and the Pursuit of Happiness and if that means the ultra-wealthy must pay their fair share of taxes for this to happen, then so be it.
---
I believe in responsible gun ownership which, when fulfilled, means that gun violence will no longer be the killer of American children.
---
I believe in the greater good of public education.
---
I believe Americans deserve the dignity of a universal healthcare plan.
---
I believe immigrants need clear paths to citizenship
---
and so much more.
---
Mayor Parker believes in striving for “a more perfect union” and invited ALL of us to Philadelphia to celebrate the 250th anniversary of our nation right in its birthplace between July 1st and 5th. (I’ll link in the comments.)
---
So let’s come together for our country in November by voting for me in the general election because when you choose Beth Farnham, you #ChooseDemocracy!
---
| |
---

---
What kind of America would you like to live in?
---
Many thanks to Gettysburg Pride for hosting their wonderful event today at the Gettysburg Rec Park. It was a beautiful, breezy day of meeting with voters in the place where the tide of the Civil War changed for Good.
---
Recognizing the humanity and equality in one another is exactly the kind of America I want to live in, for example.
---
Here are answers we received on our board where the question above was written. I encourage you to write your answers below.
---
– Safe
---
– Egalitarian state controlled by the workers
---
– One that supports each other and uplifts all
---
– A safe and loving one
---
– Inclusive, compassionate, accepting
---
– An accepting and safe one
---
– One that truly embraces and uplifts all
---
– An America where you can unafraid to be yourself, safe, with love first
---
– Low gas prices
---
– My kid can get healthcare they need
---
– Trump less
---
– To all be equal
---
– Lower gas prices
---
– Loving, free to be who you are
---
– One without the Epstein class
---
– To marry anyone we want
---
– An equal one
---
– Rule of law
---
– The true freedom for all
---
– Kind
---
– An America where we can live free
---
As you can read, attendees at a Gettysburg Pride give answers similar to those of voters who talk to me from their conservative perspective.
---
In other words all pretty much want the same things – actual freedom to be who we are, safety, freedom to create the families we choose, healthcare, equality, lower gas prices, and an America without sexual predators like Trump, Epstein, and their cronies.
---
To bring this about, we must vote for real representation in Congress which is why I ask for your vote in November.
---
Many thanks also to volunteers Jack, Bretni, Claire, Angie, Chris, Sue, and Barb for helping staff the booth.
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy !

| | Dear Peter,
**The nation's most well-known political prisoner has endorsed the socialist money can’t buy!**
Mumia Abu-Jamal, revolutionary and former Black Panther, has been imprisoned for 44 years on false charges brought by the capitalist state against him as part of the overall wave of repressive and murderous attacks on the Black Panthers.
Amnesty International described the handling of Mumia’s case as, “in violation of minimum international standards that govern fair trial procedures and the use of the death penalty.” Mumia has battled the courts for years and written numerous books about the mass incarceration system, racism, U.S. imperialism, and his experience as a Black Panther.
**Mumia is endorsing fellow revolutionary socialist Kshama Sawant from prison:**
_"When was the last time you heard a politician make a promise to you? When did they keep it?_
_"Politicians of Democratic and/or Republican stripe are beholden to capital. The bigger and vital the issue, the higher they are beholden! We know this. We've lived this. Right?_
_"Kshama doesn't come from that rat-pack! She's running on the Revolutionary Workers party's socialist program._
_"Given her proud political background and experience as a three-term elected socialist to Seattle's City Council, she more than deserves to be elected as the nation's first revolutionary socialist in Congress._
_"Kshama Sawant for Congress!"_
\- Mumia Abu-Jamal
**Also endorsing Kshama is Mumia’s personal physician, Dr. Ricardo Alvarez.**
**Dr. Alvarez says:**
_“I thank you Kshama for your powerful campaign of resilient love and for the ability to find a language to touch the hearts and minds of our fellow citizens in response to the death spiral of a dying empire.”_
In response to these crucial endorsements, Kshama has said:
_“It is an incredible honor and pride for me to have Mumia’s support in our fight against the two parties of the warmongering billionaire class. My campaign and I send our best wishes to Mumia and his family. We will be fighting here as we come to the last two months of this primary election. We are also honored to have the support and endorsement of Mumia’s personal physician, Dr. Ricardo Alvarez._
_“I join the countless people in America and internationally who have demanded for decades, and continue to demand, that Mumia be released immediately. I also join the call for Mumia to urgently receive medical care to save his eyesight. I am outraged that the state has_[ _criminally neglected_](https://us.list-manage.com/y5eCYTmfmEH?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) _Mumia’s health and vision on top of having unjustly incarcerated him for nearly five decades.”_
Mumia has always maintained his complete innocence in the murder of Philadelphia police officer Daniel Faulkner in 1981. Mumia’s attorneys have said repeatedly that evidence shows his trial was [scandalously rife](https://us.list-manage.com/150yNTfa4sM?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) with judicial bias and police and prosecutorial misconduct, like “withholding of evidence, bribing or coercing witnesses to lie.”
**Kshama’ campaign demands FREE MUMIA!**
Kshama is calling to end mass incarceration, shut down private prisons, stop forced and exploitative prison labor, end racist policing, and put police departments under the control of democratically elected community boards with full power over department policy, hiring, and firing. We need to end the war on Black people, and fund free healthcare and a massive expansion of affordable housing paid for by taxing the rich. Kshama is also fighting to shut down ICE and the detention centers. Both private prisons and private ICE detention centers, and all the misery and inhumanity that the prisoners and detainees are subjected to, have been a source of obscene windfall for billionaires and multimillionaires.
Kshama is fighting for an end to all weapons and tech for genocide and imperialist war.
Kshama is the only candidate in this race fighting for demands like these.
Kshama's main opponent, Democratic Congressman Adam Smith, has spent his nearly three-decade career helping billionaires and multimillionaires unleash war and misery on working and oppressed people.
Just days ago, Smith shamelessly made a joint announcement with Trump's Republican Party about a trillion new dollars for war and a shocking escalation in AI, cyber, and biotech weapons for the U.S. and Israeli militaries.
Working people need to reject both Smith and all other Democratic and Republican candidates. We need a fighter in Congress. We need Kshama.
As the only socialist on Seattle’s City Council, Kshama Sawant led the fight to win the Amazon Tax, which funds hundreds of millions of dollars of affordable housing every year by taxing big corporations like Amazon. Kshama also helped win the proposal for millions of dollars annually of that Amazon Tax to go [specifically to build housing for the Black community](https://us.list-manage.com/dBM2oxzqezR?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) in Seattle’s historically Black Central District.
**We now have only one day left to raise the remaining $5,000 to hit our $75k in May goal. We've raised over $70,000 so far this month.** Whatever you can afford to donate, pitch in by midnight tonight!
Help us elect the first ever revolutionary socialist to the U.S. Congress!
In solidarity,Kshama for Congress

You proved them wrong. Twice. | | Peter, they never thought we’d win here.

**You proved them wrong.** **Twice. We can do it again. **[**_Will you donate before midnight to help us win?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132457220/624573738/544333916?amount=10&refcode=MGP_EM_FR_260531_3_8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NGUwODI1My0zOTVkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PxMey73TsxwSnrsupOHKy0SbgXnZYoT_BvW-trx8qYM=)

That’s why this race matters beyond one district.

Because if we give up on places like this, we give up on the idea that politics can still be about trust. We give up on the idea that people can disagree, still listen, and still find something worth building together. We give up on the communities that deserve more than fear, division, and national talking points dumped into their mailboxes every October.

I’m not willing to do that.

**I hope you aren’t either.**

I’m running because people who work for a living deserve someone in Congress who understands their lives.

I’m running because reproductive freedom should not depend on your ZIP code.

I’m running because Washingtonians should be able to keep voting by mail without the President or Congress or anyone else trying to interfere.

**I’m running because this seat belongs to southwest Washington.**

Not to MAGA Republicans. Not to party bosses. Not to outside groups looking for their next trophy.

Tonight’s deadline matters because this race will be one of the hardest in the country. What we raise now determines what we can build, how many voters we can reach, and how ready we are when the attacks start flying.

body:
We need you to take a look at this.
| Peter,
Actions speak louder than words.
This weekend, we witnessed a tale of two campaigns. It showed exactly where each candidate's priorities lie.
While Graham Platner decided to use Memorial Day to host a political rally with Bernie Sanders, Senator Susan Collins was where she always is: standing respectfully with Mainers.
Following a heartbreaking tragedy, Susan attended the funeral of a fallen Maine firefighter to mourn with the community. Also, she joined a local parade to honor the brave heroes who laid down their lives to protect our country.
No grandstanding. No political stunts. Just showing up for Maine.
This is a glaring example of how each candidate operates.
Platner puts politics first. Susan Collins puts Maine first.
We cannot let out-of-touch politicians turn every sacred day into a partisan rally. We need to keep a true champion for Maine in the Senate, but Chuck Schumer and his allies are doing everything they can to buy this seat.

Is there **ANYTHING** I can say to get you to chip in before my FINAL End-of-Month fundraising deadline?
* What if I told you that dark money groups funded by MAGA mega-donors have poured over $3.8 MILLION into this primary to defeat me?
* What if I told you that every dollar we don't raise tonight is a dollar that lets them keep those ads on air unanswered and unchallenged?
* What if I told you that Donald Trump is doing everything in his power to silence people like me - _the public servants who stood up to him on January 6th and still refuse to back down?_

#### [Convinced yet? ](https://substack.com/redirect/d9cb9790-1f49-442b-8cd6-068cda6cb1b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Donate $5 or $10 to my grassroots campaign today:](https://substack.com/redirect/d9cb9790-1f49-442b-8cd6-068cda6cb1b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/d9cb9790-1f49-442b-8cd6-068cda6cb1b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The outside donors flooding this race with millions of dollars will never send you an email like this one. They don't have to. The money is already there -- bundled, wired, and untraceable -- and it keeps flowing.
We don't have that. We have you.
I know that puts a lot on your shoulders, and I don't take that lightly. But it also means something: **every dollar we raise is a dollar someone chose to give because they decided this fight was worth it.**
Right now, we need more of those people.
If just **5 local supporters** donate today, we'll crush our End-of-Month goal and have the resources we need to keep our ads on the air.
But if we come up short, we'll get outspent, outgunned, and drowned out by dark money.
#### **[Will you chip in $5 or $10 tonight and be one of the people who kept this race alive?](https://substack.com/redirect/d9cb9790-1f49-442b-8cd6-068cda6cb1b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thanks for everything.
Harry

body:
| Friend,

I know you’ve heard from me and my team quite a bit over the past few days. We’re burning the candle at both ends to try and leave no stone unturned, because we don’t want to go into June 2nd wondering if we could have done more to help the blue wave.

Can you use the personalized link below to chip in $3 before midnight? Every last dollar will make a difference: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lf-q2-2026?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132458384/624577878/1254288483?refcode=em-5.31.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGU3NzFhYTgtM2Q1ZC1mMTExLThmY2ItMDAwZDNhMTg5MDVjIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=DvBh9ChKMy3eUMTnztJMAGoJHdEDsDKR7QYd1DbCQ3I=)**

I don't believe that money will be the only factor in determining who wins this House majority, but with so many competing voices in the field, we have to work harder to reach voters. Because we rely on grassroots donors to fuel this movement, a Democratic majority can prioritize our voices in Congress - not the big money corporate interests.

Two very different scenes played outside the ICE facility in Newark, New Jersey on Saturday, as there was a small rally to show support for ICE during the day before there was another anti-ICE gathering at night.
What ended up taking place showed once again how political violence is mostly coming from the Left.
The pro-ICE rally took place at 10:00 AM. While there were still anti-ICE demonstrators nearby, police worked to ensure the Trump supporters could have their event without disruption. Barricades were placed between the two sides. While they could not get near each other, they certainly traded insults.
That said, the pro-ICE gathering remained peaceful. No acts of violence took place and when the event was over, people simply left.
[| | | | | Julio Rosas

ICE supporters chant "ICE ICE WE LOVE ICE!" as anti-ICE protesters shout back at them outside Delaney Hall. New Jersey State Police are on scene.

Contrast that to what happened when the sun went down and only the anti-ICE protesters remained.
By this point, it was only Newark Police and New Jersey State Police who were outside Delaney Hall. No ICE or HSI officers were on the line like have been the past week.
In spite of the law enforcement agencies being different, it did not matter to the rabid crowd. All hell broke loose after rioters attempted to move the barricades aside, prompting the officers to rush over. The officers were not in riot gear and seemed to be under orders to not use pepper spray to make the rioters let go of the barricades.

Hi Peter - this is Michele Tafoya.
I had a great life reporting from the sidelines of some of the most memorable football games in sports history. I don't come from the world of politics. Some folks on the far-Left say that makes me unqualified to run for politics.
I say being an outsider is an asset.
Why? Because the career politicians are the ones running this country into the ground. They oversaw unprecedented fraud, they sold us out to enrich themselves, and they pitted Americans against each other for cheap political gain - the kind of thing that drives normal people like you and me nuts.
[My candidacy for U.S. Senate will take a sledgehammer to this broken system.](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/UGhJZUOLpsmRW2aMfLXaD-adyeq4CX0JeX6DNCrjTGkWhZUKXXsGb6XhbmpW1HL4Y_7-E9Z3hZIYrYkxWGniJvm34kWAlRXGYMHCQpI79Ostgkv565ET8M8EdcfgF5icB1l_gkZQDTkbgnTJzWOsKCMSa2NQnwN5NsQbAG1ZtRay8NNsngmyKtUjWgH8hr-Jqx4Kox8TMoL3rfElJL_laV39zGTzmfGj3rO3uUxyMDZZM9wGu-VTvsYn6nOYWOUnRgPLG8iM3VWrjITaa9tmXnSTu6QgscmBAouOAyzA8ZfLvCv3o_9dZ1_7P64JfddsH6aS_QuOdbxoMfWFdxjO7ygnfvL0Ag8Z0hm2t926Au_nU7KoEzk5Qe00ipYDVKFoAmQN7m84_hXihBVO3Mb_28RPRH1haoXc0Nhhzscc0WlmLojTC0HZ8o-eDFNKF0LxxHd9Yk0s2hY5yuxVi6KIiyZ3ry4FICnKTNS3P52-uSuHulp-mqzeFmsn529VBRnFWrnvHfSKoQgGGvifdkkqK2yeP4clxakb0u7c9SY0Z9gjlzkNumm4URfHUngC-mzj9SecSh6oTkj7NSExeU6eax36pi-rVmfGeEudqYm2yXlYhciVForl9vbnZbviKnClYgEM_tzJlGYeM96UO_rycJw9XgFiYg69pMe9_d6Jq74EhFeWYRIzOwMGjeAfOSYc3w-Rz7J5kRxpK27ynZqI_JoOZ-x9QWY-tviyP2yse9dl9SxFZQjjc_-_dIhO6uaNJ0oNBmAG5Pm6M3ovNWjC0wRTW9sW9e2fJEDhODgDajFoeanRp6RabQ0_CE71DMWFkbgP/38tCEB7bL1jQdb2g2a5pwCQpsd8IIE1U/21)
Unfortunately, the system is fighting back. My opponents are quintessential political elites with a vast network of mega-donors and deep connections with special interests. Like I said, they've been at this for a long time...
But I have three (big!) things working in my favor:
1\. This is an open seat. Our sitting Senator announced her retirement, meaning there's no incumbency advantage.**
**2\. My opponents are racing each other to the far-Left. One of my opponents stunned voters by saying she regretted voting for the Laken Riley Act. The other is the sitting Lt. Governor, who was in power during the rampant fraud allegations. These extreme records don't appeal to most Minnesotans.
3\. No one in this race will outwork me. I made it to the very top of my industry by being willing to do what it takes to win. We're holding events in every corner of the state, our ads are hard-hitting, and I've got the grit and determination to win. If we can raise the funds, this race is over.
That last point is important.
[Unlike my opponents, I’m an outsider. I’m building this campaign from scratch. That means I’m wholly and completely reliant on grassroots donors to power us. I’m hoping you could help us out there.](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/Qmb_kI3dJSDXnBdzXKXj13fjp3hq766gbqyOgRUC4MrMLxsf_6k2drTCLtUwTfVrT1ilwQR803JkXEcRbN8Y3kcrdNGJinrr-LTV85-VCJbbnuJYpbweWty3GPl2Kq2OqmA856g52IdEDx_qNUPGsLJ2QvE-z6MRWNDPxGRUSg2bD0w5nV4qaAeDYlo4YUOUqjL1xT9T7PCo2y_gO36BnBF_kvwhn4dIz9ffy0UXeRbvidHBJcohraYJqI8HliBgIbifdQHo_nffewX3yp3ylau3HggtZ-ljGZAtXQij_nagqXUe9jvhPgfEbJGpZak8BCO5meU9dVhieMV_nV9tWxJdXN9qmmm_QovS2nzVU4jJ0NFRF144eXMZkW_hDLc2xW8we8th44KlxkDQmzQf76M87r1Iw5wmiD3jcVzp8XSgpxvDRxCH1lBnMyFnyob1EHc0PmFOS9C6pDs3S0CoqD5rrAPSku7Zg1yuHpshQs6W00SdebE6zUUGRu1h4_36J3pXL6ocbhogzm9gNtIaKtFGXcyf3vZKI2FivCUFbkHhpUilIUf8PvarNxqE_iRbBjXraayFDNytb0r6qWUXvC88nocC1rsy0wZMOFsEaQvEVoDxLZ6TnISdkdDR4eDDCDU5QbfTTm4KJQoqZbaQ74IKPY_krpo399DeTUocBy91N1qvfIZSKBpi1QPRsUMa1oi0O722vnquuj6hjLBm0wNgOb3t4-HZSGIycj0TsYgw02z0dwCasNOFDzZemhDOrjr1uCg6SM2ZtkPnqJ-Ho3YVyU7g0WQQ00iphMmFwgRdysSPpq6-J-4RSi3ckgVcuD98/wKEufXrkOtx09XG13pzunka7Vgoun4km/21)
Our fast-approaching major deadline is when we have to make important financial decisions for the entire year. If we come up short of any of our goals, we'll be forced to pull back our ad plans and slash our voter contact budgets.
Nothing would be worse for our race.
The only way we can shock the world and flip this race is by collecting the resources we need to max out our budgets.
We crunched the numbers, and we'll need to raise another $100,000 by the end of the month. That's the bare minimum needed to fully fund all our campaign operations.

name: eric sorensen (personal)
subject: Just the truth, Peter
body:
I’m glad I caught you before you logged off for the weekend, Peter.
Midnight tonight means there’s just one month until we have to submit our next quarterly fundraising report to the FEC – our first full period since we've had an opponent, and somehow already just 150 days until our election. Lots of people – from our Trump-supporting MAGA opponent to his megadonors – will look closely through our report to find anything they can exploit.
And Peter, there’s so many things I love about serving my community. Meeting my neighbors face-to-face, working with dedicated volunteers, local heroes, and supporters, and finding new ways to improve the lives of working families in our neck of the woods are just a few of those things.
But there is one big aspect about the whole "politics and campaigns" that I _don’t_ love: fundraising. Whether I like it or not, we simply can’t do this work without financial support.
But the frustrating fact is, with this activist court upholding _Citizens United_ , running for office is expensive. And it's that much harder when you pledge to avoid the types of dark money, corporate PAC donations that my opponent feeds off of.
I choose to spend my days actually working for my constituents and hoping that grassroots supporters like yourselves can help us with these other parts, and I wouldn't ever choose the trade-off where the call time comes first.
That's why, surprising as it may seem, a significant chunk of our donations come in from emails just like this one. And right now, we're about $4,118 short of what we'd targeted for May, to ensure we can be ready for what these next months on the trail bring.
I'm working every day to disrupt the Trump administration, from leading the charge to remove Pete Hegseth to curbing the worst insider trading and self-dealing. If you value a transparent, worker-first Congress, and appreciate this fight, it would mean the world if you could be one of the people to chip in tonight to help us continue representing IL-17 right and moving us toward a Democratic-led Congress.
Here’s a good link: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q2-2026**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132458732/624579045/526203646?refcode=em-5.31.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ODllNzA1Ni0zZjVkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gIBdAJh3KY5uvNga9ddUef9tUZ5ClucdodRsETucjps=)
I appreciate you more than you know,
-Eric

# [#]
Hi there, I’m sorry to bother you on a Sunday night — so I’ll keep this brief.

Just over a year ago, Republicans passed their Big Ugly Bill, stripping millions of healthcare, food assistance, and increasing the deficit by nearly $3 trillion.

| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110031?t=6&akid=24583%2E878179%2EYI3k1-) Hi team, Kristen McDonald Rivet here. I’m the Democrat representing Michigan’s 8th District.

At the end of this email, I’m going to ask you to [chip in $10 split between my campaign and Voter Protection Project.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110031?t=7&akid=24583%2E878179%2EYI3k1-) But first, I want to tell you why I chose to run for Congress in the first place.

My husband and I raised six kids, so I kept coming back to the same questions: what kind of country are they going to grow up in, what kind of leaders are we putting in charge, and what are we leaving them?

**So I ran.**

Because families who are doing everything right are still falling behind. Seniors who worked their whole lives now worry about affording their prescriptions. Parents sitting at the kitchen table trying to make the math work to pay for their home, childcare, and groceries each month.

I hear stories like this every single day.

So each day in Congress, I’m working to get results for them. Lower costs. Protect Social Security and Medicare. Stand up for working families. And yes – even take on billionaires like Elon Musk who put their interests over hard working families.

But standing up for working families comes with a price. MAGA super PAC attacks are ramping up. They spent more than $1 million attacking us last year – and they’ve already reserved another $2.5 million in ads for this year.

Hi friend — I want to tell you something that I've been sitting on all month. This has been a hard few years. I don't need to list everything that's happening nationally — you know it. It can feel like the structures we were taught to trust are being dismantled faster than anyone can track, and that the people making those decisions are counting on us being too exhausted to push back. And then I go to a house party in Cranston, or a community event in Woonsocket, or a neighborhood meetup somewhere I've never been before, and something different happens. People are showing up. They ask questions. Real ones — not "_who do I vote for_ " but "_how does this actually_ _work_ " and "_what can the LG's office actually do about that_ " and "_why has nobody ever explained this to me before._ " They want to understand the system, not just survive it. They want the Schoolhouse Rock version of government, where it actually makes sense, where you can see how the pieces connect, where knowing how it works gives you real power to change it.
---

Hey Peter,
I wanted to reach out one last time before I logged off for the weekend to thank you for being with us from the start of this campaign.
As we head from town to town on our Cooke County Tour, I’ve been so grateful to see the overwhelming support folks like you have given us across the district, as more and more people make it clear they’re ready for change.
It's so important that we continue to match our community's energy here, too.
Our primary election is barely 70 days away, and in the face of despair we need a strong final fundraising push to get our message of hope and change out—and to get out the vote.
You’ve been with me every step of the way, so I’m hoping you’ll chip in one more grassroots contribution to help us meet our May goal before midnight tonight. As things stand, we still need to raise $3,897 to hit our monthly goal, but with just a few supporters chipping in, we can get there. Will you step up by chipping in before midnight? Derrick Van Orden has shown that he isn’t interested in improving the lives of people in his district. He’s embarrassed us time and again with childish outbursts and radical policy positions.
I won’t solve all our problems overnight, but I’ll sure as hell try. And we might not see eye to eye on everything, but you can rest assured I’ll always listen to my community. No matter what, I’m going to fight like Hell for this region’s future.
From hearing from you, I know you’re also ready to bring Wisconsin’s Third District the working-class, homegrown leadership we deserve, and time is running short. So if you can, consider contributing whatever you’re able to keep us in a strong position into the home stretch.
Here’s the link one more time: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cooke-q2-2026](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132459228/624580788/-521162218?refcode=em-5.31.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NmZiOGU4YS00MjVkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DO5im7IdfHGJnWT_0_1k0Lky0CCqIddqJ00n3d3ExvY=)**
