name: Alex Vindman
subject: Important decisions
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Vindman for Florida
body:
# [](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1100?t=1&akid=622%2E3892029%2EVpcMd8)

Peter,
My May fundraising deadline is tonight at midnight. Tomorrow, my team and I meet to discuss our budget for June and the next phase of our campaign.
We’ll be making many important decisions, like “how early can we start getting TV ads up?” or “how many organizers can we start hiring?” It’s these decisions that could decide whether we win or lose Florida’s Senate race.
But set that aside for now. Today, I want to talk with you about another important decision: Why I am running for the United States Senate in Florida.
My family fled the Soviet Union during the height of the Cold War. We arrived in the United States seeking freedom. I joined the U.S. Army and swore an oath to protect this country that gave me so much.
In 2019, I honored that oath by blowing the whistle on Donald Trump’s corrupt phone call with Ukraine, an act that led to Trump’s first impeachment and ultimately cost me my military career.
**I am running for the Senate because my service to our country isn’t over. And while Donald Trump may have ended my military career, he will never shake my commitment to our country and our democracy.**
But there’s another reason I’m running. _Ashley Moody is my opponent._
Someone who’s traded more than $2 million in corporate stocks while she had access to insider information only Congress gets. Someone who’s screwed Florida homeowners and caved to the big insurance companies. Someone who takes money from corporations and gives them breaks, while crushing Florida families.
Ashley Moody is as extreme as they come. She was installed by special interests to rubber-stamp their agenda in the Senate. She is not Florida’s Senator — she is theirs. We have the chance to defeat her this November.
Florida’s Senate race is the most important election in the country. Control of the U.S. Senate will come down to who wins in Florida — a corrupt career politician who tried to overturn the 2020 election and voted to rip healthcare away from millions of Americans...or me.
This isn’t going to be easy. Trust me, I feel the pressure every day. But I wouldn’t be running for Senate if I didn’t know that we can win this.
Since we launched this campaign, more than 200,000 supporters have donated to help us flip Florida blue. _And right now, thousands more are donating ahead of our May fundraising deadline tonight._ Can I count on you to join that chain reaction, Peter?
[**Please, contribute $3 to our campaign before our deadline ends tonight. The only way we will win in Florida — and restore checks and balances in the Senate — is together.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/av-em-q22026?refcode=em260531-2&amount=3&refcode2=622_3892029_VpcMd8&akid=622%2E3892029%2EVpcMd8)

Peter, We’re proud to share that three major labor unions — the United Federation of Teachers (UFT), the Council of School Supervisors and Administrators (CSA), and the Civil Service Employees Association (CSEA) — have officially endorsed our campaign. UFT is one of New York City’s largest labor unions, representing 200,000 teachers, classroom paraprofessionals, and other school-based personnel. CSA represents the principals and assistant principals who lead our public schools every day. Hi Peter,

I know you've heard a lot from me and my team lately ahead of Tuesday's primary election. I can't thank you enough for sticking with me at such an important moment.

I need to be frank: I never imagined I'd be here. It was never my plan to run for Congress.

There are plenty of real issues where we need our government to take action right now. Like preventing a massive global conflict. Or bringing down the cost of housing and groceries. Or fixing our health care system. But instead of getting to work for the American people, Trump and his MAGA allies have been burning time and your tax dollars on this:
* Spending $15M to paint the Lincoln Reflecting Pool electric-blue and $100M for a giant Arch named after Trump.
* Putting Trump's own face on a $250 bill while families can barely afford groceries and gas.
* Building a UFC fighting cage on the White House lawn as a birthday present for Trump.
* Trying to slip $1 billion in taxpayer funds into a budget bill to renovate his own ballroom.
* Engineering a sham settlement without Congressional oversight to create a $1.8 billion slush fund to compensate January 6th insurrectionists and spend however they like.
* Making nearly 3,000 stock trades — roughly 60 a day — in the very companies his administration controls through policy. Essentially holding the stocks and pulling the levers that determine their value.

And all that on top of stripping health care from millions, starting unfounded wars, letting ICE detain children, and rigging district maps to lock themselves in power forever. **I’ve got four words for them: Not on my watch.** I’m fighting back against MAGA Republicans to put a stop to this unprecedented corruption, protect our basic freedoms, and put our government on the side of working people, not the rich and powerful. **And they are counting on you being too shocked and too exhausted to fight back. But we will prove them wrong. Every dollar we raise right now goes directly toward holding these people accountable for their corruption, making sure Democrats take back our majorities in November, and then righting the wrongs of this administration.** [**If it makes sense for you right now, can you chip in $28 or any amount before midnight tonight to power this movement, fight back against the GOP’s extremist agenda, and make our government work for working people?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3654?amount=28&t=8&akid=2916%2E4032634%2ERXG2jg)

body:
Friend,
I have a few minutes before I go upstairs to put the girls to bed, and I wanted to send one last note before the month ends.
I got into this race because we cannot wait six more years for change. As a father, I cannot fathom not standing up and trying to fix the status quo. I do not want my girls growing up in a world where people shy away from doing what is right because our politics are broken. I am doing this because I know we can do better, and I want to — need to — show them that.
The people I have been listening to and talking to on the campaign trail agree. They want the same things for their families — affordable housing, climate policy that will make a difference, and knowing that they can trust their government to be of service.
We are trying to bring in 500 new grassroots donors before midnight tonight. If you have been thinking about getting involved, now would be a meaningful time to do it.

body:
Hey Peter,

I know it’s a Sunday, so I’ll keep this short.

I’m reaching out one last time before our deadline hits at midnight
tonight.

We’ve had an incredible start to this cycle. We’ve taken home 12 wins, and
we’re undefeated in state legislature races. I couldn’t be more proud of
the work we’ve done together so far.

Our momentum is undeniable. But here’s the real: our work is far from
over. We have even more endorsements on the way, more races to win, and
more communities across this country that are searching for fearless
leaders who will actually fight for them.

We have to be ready with resources for what’s ahead so we can plan
properly, invest early, and show up for our candidates. Your support is
what makes this all possible.

We don’t take corporate PAC money or do the bidding of the ultra wealthy.
What we have is this movement, and the people in it who show up for each
other and our candidates when it truly counts.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5738ae77-80c5-49c4-804b-f964236687ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I was looking at two familiar words: patrimony and matrimony.
Patrimony comes from _patrimonium_ -- the inheritance of the father. Land, legacy, name, culture, faith, responsibility. It is not merely what a man receives; it is what is entrusted to him to preserve and pass on.
Matrimony comes from _matrimonium_ -- rooted in _mater_ , mother. That struck me because I had always associated matrimony mainly with romance or marriage. But the older meaning points to something deeper: the institution ordered toward family, motherhood, generation, and the continuation of life.
And that contrast matters.
A man can build a house, dig a well, work the land, defend a country, and preserve an inheritance. But he cannot create posterity by himself. A woman can nurture, form, carry, and bring forth life, but she does not become a mother apart from the union of man and woman. The point is not competition. The point is design.
In Eden, Adam was created complete as a man, but not complete as mankind. He had work. He had land. He had communion with God. He had responsibility. And yet God still said, "It is not good for man to be alone."
Eve was not taken from Adam's foot to be beneath him. She was not taken from his head to rule over him. She was taken from his side -- equal in worth, distinct in design, complementary in calling.
That is the part modern culture keeps trying to erase.
Feminism has often taught women to view dependence as weakness, men as obstacles, and family as limitation. But in doing so, it has not liberated women. It has isolated them. It has alienated men and women from one another and made even the most basic truths sound controversial.
Men and women were not created to compete for dominance. We were created for union -- to fill the earth with love, laughter, companionship, children, family, work, worship, and legacy.
So miss me with the cartoon version of independence that says a woman is most fulfilled when she needs no one, belongs to no one, and answers to no one. That is not freedom. That is exile dressed up as empowerment.
The universal principle is this: life is not sustained by autonomy alone. Civilization is built by covenant, sacrifice, duty, love, and generational responsibility.
Patrimony preserves the inheritance.
Matrimony creates the home where that inheritance can live.

# JOIN LILY
to
OFFICIALLY FILE FOR U.S. CONGRESS

Dear friends, volunteers, and supporters,

I will officially file my candidacy for the U.S. House of Representatives, New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District June 4th, 2026.

We _plan to meet at 12pm_ on the steps of State House Capitol Building Thursday June 4th, 2026

107 North Main Street, Concord, NH 03301

Signs will be provided.

We will then proceed inside to meet Secretary of State David Scanlan in his Office at 12:30pm where I will officially sign up!

I chose June 4th to file for office because it is the anniversary of the Tiananmen Square Massacre in China. This sober day highlights my personal emigration journey to the United States, and ongoing fight for freedom here at home and around the world.

37 years ago, an estimated 10,000 peaceful protesters across Beijing and more than 200 other cities nationwide were murdered by the CCP military. These victims were labeled as “Counter-Revolutionaries”, their cases sealed and Chinese words such as "June 4th",and "Tiananmen Massacre" are still banned today on the Internet in China.

In 2024, I won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against now incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in over a decade to flipping NH-02. I am back and running stronger than ever in 2026. This will be an exciting grassroots campaign.

Please help me win to keep America and New Hampshire free.

For Freedom,

Lily Tang Williams

clean_body: This past month, I've traveled across the country to meet the women at the center of this fight. | = Hey Peter, it's Jessica. This past month, I've been traveling across the country meeting with candidates, staff, and volunteers who are working every day to defeat Republicans and take back power. And I want to be very clear about what I'm seeing: Republicans are beatable. I've spent time with women running fearless campaigns against Republicans who voted against their constituents, attacked basic freedoms, and stood with Trump's MAGA agenda at every turn. I've watched campaign teams building the kind of operations it takes to win. I've met volunteers who are knocking doors, making calls, and doing the hard work that turns a tough district into a real pickup opportunity. That's what our On Notice Fund is about. This is how we make sure that when we say a Republican is vulnerable, we have the resources to prove it. = | = When we launched this end-of-month fund, we put 100 Republicans on notice. And that isn't just a warning — it’s a strategy. It means recruiting the right candidates, training them, investing early, and fighting beside them all the way to Election Day. And that work depends on this community.
